sql.text:
storno AS (
  SELECT "TransId"    AS T FROM {{SCHEMA}}.OJDT
   WHERE "StornoToTr" IS NOT NULL AND "StornoToTr" <> 0
  UNION
  SELECT "StornoToTr" AS T FROM {{SCHEMA}}.OJDT
   WHERE "StornoToTr" IS NOT NULL AND "StornoToTr" <> 0
),

-- ---- JIVO group / branch counterparties (see TRAP 6) -------------------------
-- Two tests, because neither alone is enough: the branch GROUP catches the
-- BRANCH CUSTOMER / BRANCH VENDOR families, and the NAME catches the group
-- companies filed in an ordinary trade group (Mart's VENDA000001 'JIVO WELLNESS
-- PVT LTD' sits in group 106 PURCHASE).  Verified to cover all 23 known group
-- CardCodes in all three books without dragging in a real third party.
grpbp AS (
  SELECT c."CardCode" AS CC
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.OCRD c
  LEFT JOIN {{SCHEMA}}.OCRG g
    ON g."GroupCode" = c."GroupCode" AND g."GroupType" = c."CardType"
  WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(g."GroupName",'')) LIKE '%BRANCH%'
     OR UPPER(COALESCE(c."CardName" ,'')) LIKE '%JIVO%'
),
-- DISTINCT is load-bearing: without it this left join would fan the ledger out.
grptx AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT j."TransId" AS T
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.JDT1 j
  WHERE j."ShortName" IN (SELECT CC FROM grpbp)
),

-- ---- the twelve month slots of the window (dense, zero-filled later) ---------
mslot AS (
  SELECT 0 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 1  FROM DUMMY UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 3  FROM DUMMY UNION ALL
  SELECT 4 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 5  FROM DUMMY UNION ALL
  SELECT 6 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 7  FROM DUMMY UNION ALL
  SELECT 8 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 9  FROM DUMMY UNION ALL
  SELECT 10 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 11 FROM DUMMY
),
months AS (
  SELECT TO_VARCHAR(ADD_MONTHS(p.WSTART, s.N), 'YYYY-MM') AS M
  FROM params p CROSS JOIN mslot s
),

-- ---- when this book's banking ledger opens, and each account's opening -------
openday AS (
  -- Gated by the as-of: without it, a position taken BEFORE the book opened
  -- reports a future opening balance against a nil closing balance (measured on
  -- Mart at --as-of 2024-11-30: 80.03 L of "opening" on a book that opens
  -- 2024-12-31).  NULL here simply zeroes every OPENING_BAL_L.
  SELECT MIN(j."RefDate") AS OPEN_D
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.JDT1 j
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE j."Account" IN (SELECT GL FROM univ)
    AND j."RefDate" <= p.ASOF
),

-- ---- ledger position and lifetime footprint ---------------------------------
bal AS (
  SELECT j."Account"                                                        AS GL,
         SUM(CASE WHEN j."RefDate" <= p.ASOF
                  THEN CAST(j."Debit" AS DOUBLE) - CAST(j."Credit" AS DOUBLE)
                  ELSE 0 END)                                               AS BAL,
         SUM(CASE WHEN j."RefDate" = o.OPEN_D
                  THEN CAST(j."Debit" AS DOUBLE) - CAST(j."Credit" AS DOUBLE)
                  ELSE 0 END)                                               AS OPENING,
         -- ...but FIRST/LAST MOVEMENT are about REAL traffic, so a cancelled
         -- payment and its reversal must not make a dead account look alive.
         MIN(CASE WHEN j."RefDate" <= p.ASOF AND st.T IS NULL
                  THEN j."RefDate" END)                                     AS FIRSTMV,
         MAX(CASE WHEN j."RefDate" <= p.ASOF AND st.T IS NULL
                  THEN j."RefDate" END)                                     AS LASTMV
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.JDT1 j
  CROSS JOIN params p
  CROSS JOIN openday o
  LEFT JOIN storno st ON st.T = j."TransId"
  WHERE j."Account" IN (SELECT GL FROM univ)
  GROUP BY j."Account"
),

-- ---- movement, one row per account per month inside the 12-month window -----
mon AS (
  SELECT j."Account"                              AS GL,
         TO_VARCHAR(j."RefDate",'YYYY-MM')        AS M,
         -- st.T IS NULL  =  a line that was not cancelled and is not a reversal
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL THEN CAST(j."Debit"  AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS MIN_,
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL THEN CAST(j."Credit" AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS MOUT_,
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                          AS NL,
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL AND j."TransType" = '30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NJE,
         -- the churn that was removed, kept visible instead of vanishing
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(j."Debit" AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS MCANC,
         -- of the REAL traffic, how much sat in a transaction that also touched a
         -- JIVO group / branch party
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL AND gx.T IS NOT NULL
                  THEN CAST(j."Debit"  AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)                  AS MGIN,
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL AND gx.T IS NOT NULL
                  THEN CAST(j."Credit" AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)                  AS MGOUT
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.JDT1 j
  CROSS JOIN params p
  LEFT JOIN storno st ON st.T = j."TransId"
  LEFT JOIN grptx  gx ON gx.T = j."TransId"
  WHERE j."Account" IN (SELECT GL FROM univ)
    AND j."RefDate" >= p.WSTART
    AND j."RefDate" <= p.ASOF
  GROUP BY j."Account", TO_VARCHAR(j."RefDate",'YYYY-MM')
),
mv AS (
  SELECT GL,
         SUM(MIN_)   AS IN12,
         SUM(MOUT_)  AS OUT12,
         SUM(NL)     AS NL12,
         SUM(NJE)    AS NJE12,
         SUM(MCANC)  AS CANC12,
         SUM(MGIN)   AS GIN12,
         SUM(MGOUT)  AS GOUT12,
         -- months that actually moved: NL, not COUNT(*), or a month whose only
         -- traffic was a cancelled payment would still count as active.
         SUM(CASE WHEN NL > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ACTMON
  FROM mon
  GROUP BY GL
),
-- every account x every one of the 12 slots, zero where nothing moved
dense AS (
  SELECT u.GL                       AS GL,
         mo.M                       AS M,
         COALESCE(m.MIN_,  0)       AS DIN,
         COALESCE(m.MOUT_, 0)       AS DOUT
  FROM univ u
  CROSS JOIN months mo
  LEFT JOIN mon m ON m.GL = u.GL AND m.M = mo.M
),
ser AS (
  -- TRAP: CAST(<double> AS DECIMAL(n,2)) TRUNCATES in HANA - it does not round.
  -- ROUND(0.11507,2) is a double a hair under 0.12, and the cast then chops it to
  -- 0.11, so a naive series is biased DOWN by up to a paisa a month (measured:
  -- Oil 2201405 lost 0.09 L over 12 months against its own 12m total).  Rounding
  -- inside the DECIMAL domain - TO_DECIMAL first, ROUND second - is exact, and is
  -- what keeps MONTHLY_*_SERIES adding back to RECEIPTS_IN_12M_L /
  -- PAYMENTS_OUT_12M_L.  Residual measured after the storno fix: at most 0.02 L on
  -- any account in any book - twelve 2dp values cannot sum to a 2dp total exactly.
  SELECT GL,
         STRING_AGG(M||'='||TO_VARCHAR(CAST(ROUND(TO_DECIMAL(DIN /100000,28,6),2)
                                            AS DECIMAL(18,2))),
                    ';' ORDER BY M)                                    AS SER_IN,
         STRING_AGG(M||'='||TO_VARCHAR(CAST(ROUND(TO_DECIMAL(DOUT/100000,28,6),2)
                                            AS DECIMAL(18,2))),
                    ';' ORDER BY M)                                    AS SER_OUT,
         STRING_AGG(M||'='||TO_VARCHAR(CAST(ROUND(TO_DECIMAL((DIN-DOUT)/100000,28,6),2)
                                            AS DECIMAL(18,2))),
                    ';' ORDER BY M)                                    AS SER_NET
  FROM dense
  GROUP BY GL
),

-- ---- assemble ---------------------------------------------------------------
core AS (
  SELECT u.GL, u.GLNAME, u.DRAWER, u.CATEGORY, u.CATEGORY_KIND,
         u.IS_CASH_AND_BANK, u.CURRTOTAL, u.NAME_DIGITS,
         p.ASOF, p.CC_RATE, o.OPEN_D,
         COALESCE(b.BAL, 0)                                            AS BAL,
         COALESCE(b.OPENING, 0)                                        AS OPENING,
         b.FIRSTMV, b.LASTMV,
         COALESCE(m.IN12, 0)                                           AS IN12,
         COALESCE(m.OUT12, 0)                                          AS OUT12,
         COALESCE(m.NL12, 0)                                           AS NL12,
         COALESCE(m.NJE12, 0)                                          AS NJE12,
         COALESCE(m.ACTMON, 0)                                         AS ACTMON,
         COALESCE(m.CANC12, 0)                                         AS CANC12,
         COALESCE(m.GIN12, 0)                                          AS GIN12,
         COALESCE(m.GOUT12, 0)                                         AS GOUT12,
         s.SER_IN, s.SER_OUT, s.SER_NET,
         h.BANKCODE                                                    AS H_BANKCODE,
         h.ACCTNO                                                      AS H_ACCTNO,
         h.BRANCH                                                      AS H_BRANCH,
         -- does the DSC1 house-bank row actually describe THIS G/L account?
         CASE
           WHEN h.ACCTNO_DIGITS IS NULL OR h.ACCTNO_DIGITS = ''  THEN NULL
           WHEN u.NAME_DIGITS = ''                               THEN 'UNKNOWN'
           WHEN u.NAME_DIGITS LIKE '%'||h.ACCTNO_DIGITS||'%'
             OR h.ACCTNO_DIGITS LIKE '%'||u.NAME_DIGITS||'%'     THEN 'AGREE'
           ELSE 'MISMATCH'
         END                                                           AS H_AGREE,
         bm.BANKCODE                                                   AS O_BANKCODE,
         bm.BANKNAME                                                   AS O_BANKNAME
  FROM univ u
  CROSS JOIN params p
  CROSS JOIN openday o
  LEFT JOIN bal       b  ON b.GL  = u.GL
  LEFT JOIN mv        m  ON m.GL  = u.GL
  LEFT JOIN ser       s  ON s.GL  = u.GL
  LEFT JOIN house     h  ON h.GL  = u.GL
  LEFT JOIN bankmatch bm ON bm.GL = u.GL
)
SELECT
  '{{SCHEMA}}'                                                    AS COMPANY_SCHEMA,
  c.ASOF                                                          AS AS_OF,
  c.CATEGORY                                                      AS CATEGORY,
  c.CATEGORY_KIND                                                 AS CATEGORY_KIND,
  c.IS_CASH_AND_BANK                                              AS IS_CASH_AND_BANK,
  c.GL                                                            AS GL_ACCT_CODE,
  c.DRAWER                                                        AS GL_DRAWER,
  REPLACE_REGEXPR('[0-9]' IN c.GLNAME WITH 'x' OCCURRENCE ALL)    AS GL_ACCT_LABEL_MASKED,
  COALESCE(CASE WHEN c.H_AGREE = 'AGREE' THEN c.H_BANKCODE END,
           c.O_BANKCODE)                                          AS BANK_CODE,
  COALESCE(c.O_BANKNAME,
           CASE WHEN UPPER(c.GLNAME) LIKE '%BANK%'
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR_REGEXPR('^[A-Z& ]+' IN
                       REPLACE_REGEXPR('^(FDR|LOAN TERM|LOAN|TERM)[ .:-]*' IN
                                       UPPER(c.GLNAME) WITH ''))), '')
           END)                                                   AS BANK_NAME,
  CASE WHEN c.O_BANKNAME IS NOT NULL             THEN 'ODSC_MASTER'
       WHEN UPPER(c.GLNAME) LIKE '%BANK%'
        AND TRIM(SUBSTR_REGEXPR('^[A-Z& ]+' IN
              REPLACE_REGEXPR('^(FDR|LOAN TERM|LOAN|TERM)[ .:-]*' IN
                              UPPER(c.GLNAME) WITH ''))) <> ''    THEN 'GL_ACCT_NAME'
       ELSE 'UNRESOLVED' END                                      AS BANK_NAME_SOURCE,
  CASE WHEN c.H_AGREE = 'AGREE' THEN c.H_BRANCH END                AS BRANCH,
  CASE WHEN c.H_ACCTNO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END          AS IS_HOUSE_BANK,
  COALESCE(c.H_AGREE, 'NO_HOUSE_BANK_ROW')                        AS HOUSE_BANK_AGREES,
  CASE
    WHEN c.H_AGREE = 'AGREE' AND LENGTH(c.H_ACCTNO) >= 4
      THEN 'xxxx'||RIGHT(c.H_ACCTNO, 4)
    WHEN LENGTH(c.NAME_DIGITS) >= 4
      THEN 'xxxx'||RIGHT(c.NAME_DIGITS, 4)
    ELSE NULL
  END                                                             AS ACCT_NO_MASKED,
  CASE
    WHEN c.H_AGREE = 'AGREE' AND LENGTH(c.H_ACCTNO) >= 4 THEN 'DSC1_HOUSE_BANK'
    WHEN LENGTH(c.NAME_DIGITS) >= 4                      THEN 'GL_ACCT_NAME'
    ELSE 'NONE'
  END                                                             AS ACCT_NO_SOURCE,
  CASE
    WHEN c.H_AGREE = 'AGREE' AND LENGTH(c.H_ACCTNO) >= 4
      THEN LENGTH(REPLACE_REGEXPR('[^0-9]' IN c.H_ACCTNO WITH '' OCCURRENCE ALL))
    ELSE LENGTH(c.NAME_DIGITS)
  END                                                             AS ACCT_NO_NDIGITS,

  ROUND(c.BAL       / 100000, 2)                                  AS BALANCE_L,
  ROUND(c.CURRTOTAL / 100000, 2)                                  AS CURRTOTAL_TODAY_L,
  CASE WHEN ROUND(c.BAL,2) > 0 THEN 'DEBIT'
       WHEN ROUND(c.BAL,2) < 0 THEN 'CREDIT'
       ELSE 'NIL' END                                             AS BALANCE_SIGN,
  ROUND(CASE WHEN c.BAL > 0 THEN c.BAL ELSE 0 END / 100000, 2)    AS FUNDS_AVAILABLE_L,
  ROUND(CASE WHEN c.BAL < 0 THEN -c.BAL ELSE 0 END / 100000, 2)   AS AMOUNT_DRAWN_L,
  -- an asset-side account in credit is a genuine overdraw / booking error;
  -- a CC/OD or loan account in credit is simply borrowing, and is NOT flagged.
  CASE WHEN c.CATEGORY IN ('CURRENT_ACCOUNT','PAYMENT_WALLET','CASH_IN_HAND',
                           'FIXED_DEPOSIT')
             AND c.BAL < -100 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END               AS OVERDRAWN_FLAG,
  CASE WHEN c.CATEGORY_KIND = 'BORROWING' OR c.CATEGORY = 'CASH_CREDIT_OD'
       THEN ROUND((CASE WHEN c.BAL < 0 THEN -c.BAL ELSE 0 END) * c.CC_RATE / 100000, 2)
       ELSE 0 END                                                 AS EST_ANNUAL_INTEREST_L,

  ROUND(c.IN12  / 100000, 2)                                      AS RECEIPTS_IN_12M_L,
  ROUND(c.OUT12 / 100000, 2)                                      AS PAYMENTS_OUT_12M_L,
  ROUND((c.IN12 - c.OUT12) / 100000, 2)                           AS NET_12M_L,
  ROUND(c.OUT12 / (CASE WHEN c.ACTMON = 0 THEN 1 ELSE c.ACTMON END) / 100000, 2)
                                                                  AS AVG_MONTHLY_OUT_L,
  ROUND(c.CANC12 / 100000, 2)                                     AS CANCELLED_GROSS_12M_L,

terms.label: Storno-paired lines
terms.note: doc-type agnostic, so it also catches reversed MANUAL journal entries that the ORCT/OVPM Canceled flag misses (4 extra lines Oil, 8 Mart, 0 Bev)

terms.label: Share of the pre-fix gross
terms.note: Oil 14.72%, Mart 20.61%, Bev 11.58% of what a naive SUM(Debit) would have reported

check.method: reproduces the figure measured independently from the SQL when the section was catalogued

bank-cash-and-bank-headline.closure_note: Terms describe how the query built this figure; they are not addends over a row set, so no arithmetic closure is asserted.

excludes.label: Fixed deposits and term/vehicle/card debt
excludes.why: deliberately outside the column (sql line 284-286); they are carried separately in TOT_FIXED_DEPOSIT_L and TOT_BORROWINGS_L

bank-cash-and-bank-headline.formula: TOT_CASH_AND_BANK_L x 1e5 = SUM(BALANCE_L where IS_CASH_AND_BANK='Y') = current accounts + wallets + cash + CASH_CREDIT_OD. Published ON PURPOSE so the reader can see why the hero card does not use it: because it nets the drawn overdraft into 'cash', Oil's cash-and-bank is MINUS Rs 37.65 Cr.
bank-cash-and-bank-headline.label: "Cash and bank" as the column defines it

rows.filter: True   # one-company slice, so agg='first' takes exactly ONE row. If the three slices are ever concatenated, de-duplicate on COMPANY_SCHEMA before taking first, exactly as site/index.html:1595 does.

section_traps: BROADCAST COLUMNS. The seven TOT_* columns are company-level window totals (SUM(...) OVER (), sql lines 614-628) repeated IDENTICALLY on every row. Summing one across rows multiplies it by the row count: Oil's TOT_BORROWINGS_L summed over 70 rows gives 601,615 L = Rs 6,016 Cr against a true Rs 85.95 Cr. Every TOT_* KPI must use agg='first' on one row per company, and a concatenated multi-company array must be de-duplicated on COMPANY_SCHEMA first (site/index.html:1595 does exactly this).

The seven TOT_* columns are NOT DISJOINT and must never be added together. TOT_CASH_AND_BANK_L already contains TOT_BANK_CURRENT_L + TOT_CASH_IN_HAND_L + TOT_WALLET_L + TOT_CC_OD_NET_L, and TOT_BORROWINGS_L (gross drawn) overlaps TOT_CC_OD_NET_L (net). Read ONE per question. The per-account columns, by contrast, ARE safe to sum: one row per G/L account, no fan-out, no faceting.

'Cash and bank' is not cash. TOT_CASH_AND_BANK_L includes the drawn overdraft, so Oil's is -3,765.06 L = MINUS Rs 37.65 Cr. The hero card deliberately publishes 'Net bank position' = current + cash + wallets + deposits - abs(borrowings) instead, because JIVO holds almost nothing in current accounts and funds itself on cash credit: a cash-and-bank headline would read as liquidity the business does not have. Oil's real net position is -Rs 74.86 Cr. Keep that reasoning attached to the number wherever it is shown.

Oil's liquid position is NEGATIVE: -5.02 L across current accounts, wallets and cash. Of that, cash in hand is -10.12 L because 1105001 CASH SALE sits at -10.23 L - a till in CREDIT, which cannot physically happen. Do not present it as 'cash held'; it is a control finding (OVERDRAWN_FLAG='Y'). Mart's main operating account 1104108 ICICI is likewise at -2.17 L with Rs 122 Cr flowing through it in the year.

CANCELLED PAYMENTS WERE ONCE DOUBLE-COUNTED IN EVERY GROSS-MOVEMENT COLUMN. SAP posts a cancellation as the original PLUS a mirror-image reversal and marks BOTH rows cancelled (C-0021: CANCELED is three-valued N/Y/C, so a Canceled='Y' test is not enough on its own). Before the fix Oil's receipts read 101,144.62 L against a true 86,464.88 L - an inflation of Rs 146.80 Cr, +14.5%; Mart +20.5%, Bev +11.6%. The fix filters both halves via OJDT.StornoToTr, which is DOC-TYPE AGNOSTIC and so also catches reversed manual journal entries the ORCT/OVPM flag misses (4 extra lines Oil, 8 Mart, 0 Bev). Today's removal: Oil 14,940.37 L (14.7%), Mart 4,933.42 L (20.6%), Bev 299.07 L (11.6%), all carried in CANCELLED_GROSS_12M_L. Any comparison against an extract older than 2026-08-21 will differ by exactly this amount.

BALANCE_L and OPENING_BAL_L deliberately do NOT filter cancellations, and that is correct: the storno pair nets to exactly zero per account, so the ledger still equals what SAP itself reports even at an as-of falling between an original payment and its later reversal. Applying the movement filter to the balance would break the tie to OACT.CurrTotal. Never 'fix' this asymmetry.

MONTHLY_IN_L_SERIES / MONTHLY_OUT_L_SERIES / MONTHLY_NET_L_SERIES ARE STRINGS, NOT SCALARS - twelve 'YYYY-MM=<lakhs>' pairs joined by ';'. They feed a lineArea chart and are parsed, never summed and never passed to a unit scaler. Their names contain '_L_' but END in '_SERIES', so unit detection must anchor at the END of the column name; a scaler keyed on 'contains _L' would multiply a string by 1e5.

EVERY money column is INR LAKHS and ENDS in _L (x1e5). Anchor unit detection to the END of the name: TOT_CC_OD_NET_L, MANUAL_JE_LINE_PCT_12M and MONTHLY_NET_L_SERIES all carry misleading tokens mid-name. A column ending _L is lakhs no matter what else is in it; a column not ending _L is not money, even if it contains '_L_'. Non-money columns: N_LINES_12M, ACTIVE_MONTHS_12M, DAYS_SINCE_LAST_MOVE, ACCT_NO_NDIGITS, MANUAL_JE_LINE_PCT_12M.

SUMMING AMOUNT_DRAWN_L OVER ALL ROWS IS NOT BORROWINGS. Oil gives 8,605.14 L against a true 8,594.50 L: the extra 10.65 L is a cash till and a PayTM wallet sitting in credit. The correct predicate is the one the SQL uses at lines 581 and 626 - CATEGORY_KIND='BORROWING' OR CATEGORY='CASH_CREDIT_OD' - because CASH_CREDIT_OD is KIND='BANK', not 'BORROWING'.

GROSS versus NET borrowings. TOT_BORROWINGS_L counts only the drawn (negative) side, so the two Oil facilities sitting in DEBIT - 2201105 HSBC +806.68 L and 1104107 ICICI +684.51 L, 1,491.19 L together - are invisible to it. Gross Rs 85.95 Cr, net Rs 71.03 Cr. Gross is the right reading for 'what the banks have lent us'; it is the wrong reading for 'what we would repay today'.

SUMMING FUNDS_AVAILABLE_L ACROSS ROWS IS NOT LIQUIDITY. Oil's 2,610.16 L is 1,491.19 L of over-repaid CC/OD facilities (not cash) plus 1,113.33 L of fixed deposits (not on call), leaving 5.64 L. v1's per-row column label 'available' is fine; a column total under it would not be.

TOT_BORROWINGS_L is BANK borrowings only. 2202000 UNSECURED LOAN - directors', subsidiary and NBFC debt, Oil ~2,330 L, Mart ~233 L, Bev nil - is deliberately outside this register (sql lines 80-83). Anyone quoting 'total borrowings Rs 85.95 Cr' off this page is quoting bank debt; Oil's total debt is about Rs 109 Cr.

READ DEBIT AND CREDIT PHYSICALLY, NOT BY ACCOUNT TYPE. On a CC/OD or loan account a Debit is money going IN (a repayment) and a Credit is money going OUT (a drawdown or an interest charge). Oil's CC/OD accounts carry 82,747.20 L of 'payments out' in twelve months - that is the business settling its bills from the facility, not new borrowing, and 94.1% of everything Oil pays out leaves from a borrowed account rather than a current account.

BALANCE_SIGN is computed on the RUPEE balance; BALANCE_L is rounded to 2 dp of a lakh (Rs 1,000 granularity). A row can therefore read BALANCE_L 0.00 with BALANCE_SIGN 'DEBIT' - live: Mart 1105001 CASH SALE. Derive direction from BALANCE_SIGN, never from the sign of the rounded column, and never filter 'carrying a balance' on BALANCE_L alone if sub-Rs 1,000 balances matter.

OVERDRAWN_FLAG fires only on ASSET-side categories and only below -Rs 100 in RUPEES. A CC/OD or loan account in credit is borrowing and is deliberately not flagged - do not 'fix' that. And because the threshold is in rupees while BALANCE_L is rounded to Rs 1,000, an account between -Rs 100 and -Rs 500 is flagged while its balance column reads -0.00. Live counts: Oil 2, Mart 3, Bev 0.

DORMANT_90D_FLAG is 'Y' both for a balance that went quiet AND for an account that has NEVER moved (LAST_MOVE_DATE NULL). 44 Oil / 34 Mart / 14 Bev rows carry it; only 24 / 1 / 1 carry a balance. Worse, 21 of Oil's 24 are FIXED DEPOSITS holding 1,113.33 L that all last moved on 2026-03-31 - a deposit that moves once a year at interest posting is dormant BY DESIGN. Ex-deposits, the genuinely idle money is 1.34 L Oil, 1.42 L Mart, 0.00 L Bev. Quoting Rs 11.15 Cr of 'idle bank money' for Oil would be wrong by three orders of magnitude.

NEVER_USED_FLAG means 'never REALLY moved', not 'never posted'. Movement is storno-filtered, so an account whose only traffic was a cancelled payment reads 'Y': live, Mart 1104107 is NEVER_USED='Y' with 2.21 L of CANCELLED_GROSS_12M_L and N_LINES_12M = 0. Cross-read the two columns before calling an account unused.

IS_HOUSE_BANK='Y' only means a DSC1 row EXISTS - not that it is right. DSC1 is nearly empty and partly wrong: Oil 5 rows, Bev 3, Mart 1 (with a NULL GLAccount, so Mart gets zero matches at all), against 13-30 live bank G/L accounts a book, and Beverages' rows were copied from Oil's chart and still carry Oil's G/L codes. Bev 1104102 is IS_HOUSE_BANK='Y' with HOUSE_BANK_AGREES='MISMATCH'. v1 renders a green 'house' pill off IS_HOUSE_BANK alone (site/index.html:1503) - read HOUSE_BANK_AGREES instead, and expect BRANCH to be NULL on every Mart and Beverages row.

THE ACCOUNT-CODE PREFIX LIES, and ActType/CashBox do not mark bank accounts. Oil's 1104106/07/08/10 carry 1104* ('BANK ACCOUNTS') codes but hang under BANK CASH CREDIT LOAN and come out CASH_CREDIT_OD; 1103114-17 carry 1103* (STOCKS) codes but hang under FDR; 2201104 and 2201402 hang under TERM LOAN. Every one of Oil's 70 banking accounts has ActType='N' and CashBox='N' - and so do ~984 other postable accounts. The universe is the parent drawer NAME through OACT.FatherNum, never LIKE '1104%' and never a flag.

INTERCO_IN_12M_L / INTERCO_OUT_12M_L are TRANSACTION-level attributions, so they are an UPPER BOUND, never an allocation: a journal that touches one JIVO group party contributes its WHOLE bank line. Mart pays 87.6% of everything out to JIVO group/branch parties, so reading its PAYMENTS_OUT_12M_L as third-party spend overstates it about eightfold. The test is OCRG.GroupName LIKE '%BRANCH%' OR OCRD.CardName LIKE '%JIVO%' - the group test alone misses Mart's largest payable VENDA000001 'JIVO WELLNESS PVT LTD', which sits in an ordinary PURCHASE group, and the 23 known group CardCodes (C-0005) are book-specific and cannot be hardcoded across three schemas.

EST_ANNUAL_INTEREST_L is an INPUT CONSTANT (8.47%, sql line 255) applied to TODAY's drawn balance - not an accrual, not a measured cost, and not comparable with the P&L. Oil's 727.97 L sits about 57% above the 463.37 L actually debited to 5610001 INTEREST ON BANK LOAN over the same twelve months (measured 2026-08-21, ~7.53% gross on an average drawn 6,148.65 L). Some borrowing cost also sits on other accounts (2163024 TRADEPAY interest payable, 2163026 term-loan interest payable). Present it as an upper-bound run-rate, never as interest paid.

AVG_MONTHLY_OUT_L divides by ACTIVE months, not by 12 - deliberately, so a seasonal account is not flattered. The cost: Oil 2201211 reads 1,500.00 L 'per month' off a single Rs 15 Cr term-loan repayment in one active month. Never annualise it by x12, and never rank accounts on it.

MANUAL_JE_LINE_PCT_12M is a share of LINES, not of value, and it is NULL - not 0 - where the account had no 12-month traffic (Oil 14 / Mart 33 / Bev 12 rows). It reads 100.0 on any account with a single line, so an unweighted average is meaningless: measured 45.6% unweighted against 5.4% line-weighted in Oil. Only three TransTypes ever touch these accounts (24 incoming, 46 outgoing, 30 manual JE); no invoice posts to a bank account directly.

CURRTOTAL_TODAY_L is a LIFETIME balance and is NOT filtered by as_of. It equals BALANCE_L exactly on all 132 rows today, which is what makes it a valid independent cross-check - but any historical as-of run will make it legitimately disagree, and the check dot must then read 'not applicable at this as-of', not red. Beverages' JDT1 does hold lines out to 2026-12-31, so the <= as_of guard is not decorative.

ROUNDING IS COARSE AND ASYMMETRIC. Every _L column is ROUND(x/1e5, 2) = Rs 1,000 granularity, and the TOT_* window totals round AFTER summing in rupees while a per-row sum rounds first. Live deltas today: Oil cash-in-hand -0.01 L, fixed deposits +0.01 L, borrowings -0.01 L. The monthly series adds back to the 12-month totals within 0.02 L per account (HANA's CAST(double AS DECIMAL) TRUNCATES, so the SQL rounds inside the DECIMAL domain). Every check needs a Rs 1,000 x rowcount tolerance; exact equality WILL false-alarm.

BOOK_OPENING_DATE is DERIVED per book, never hardcoded to the 2024-09-30 go-live: MART'S BANKING LEDGER OPENS 2024-12-31, with nothing before it. A hardcoded go-live returns 0 for every Mart account. OPENING_BAL_L is gated by as_of after a fix on 2026-08-21 - before it, an as-of BEFORE the book opened reported a FUTURE opening balance (measured: Mart at --as-of 2024-11-30 showed 80.03 L of opening against a nil closing balance). Beverages has 0.00 opening on all 18 rows, a measured nil.

THERE IS NO DETAIL SLICE. detail is [] in all three books, so no page may offer a drill to individual JDT1 lines, a payment list, a cheque number or a statement view. gl-account.html for a bank account can show only the 51 summary columns for that account, its three monthly series, and its history.jsonl trend. Whether the G/L position agrees with what the bank says is bank-reco's job (OBNK), not this section's - this section never touches OBNK.

THERE IS NO FACILITY LIMIT ANYWHERE IN THIS DATA. Sanctioned limits, drawing power and margin are not in ODSC, DSC1 or OACT, so 'headroom', '% of limit used' and 'available credit' cannot be computed here and must not be implied by a gauge, a progress bar or a phrase like 'available'. FUNDS_AVAILABLE_L is a debit balance, not a credit line.

This is a G/L register, not a party or document register - no CardCode, no DocEntry, no DocStatus, so C-0019 / C-0021's document half do not bite here. What does bite: these figures cannot be added to any other section. Bank movement is not turnover, INTERCO_* overlaps whatever the ageing sections flag as intercompany, and 'total liabilities = payables + provisions + borrowings' is not a supported sum.

ACCOUNT NUMBERS ARE SENSITIVE AND ARE NEVER EMITTED IN FULL. They live INSIDE OACT.AcctName, so the raw account name never leaves the query: GL_ACCT_LABEL_MASKED x's every digit and ACCT_NO_MASKED is 'xxxx' + last 4. Never join this section back to OACT.AcctName to 'improve' a label, never widen the mask, and never treat ACCT_NO_MASKED NULL (9 Oil / 6 Mart / 5 Bev rows) as an error - it means the books hold fewer than four digits for that account. GL_ACCT_CODE is a chart code, not a bank account number, and is safe.

sql.text:
CASE WHEN f."AcctName" IN ('BANK ACCOUNTS','PAYMENT BANK ONLINE',
                                    'CASH IN HAND','BANK CASH CREDIT LOAN')
              THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END                      AS IS_CASH_AND_BANK,
         -- digits embedded in the account name (the bank account number)
         REPLACE_REGEXPR('[^0-9]' IN a."AcctName" WITH '' OCCURRENCE ALL)
                                                         AS NAME_DIGITS
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.OACT a
  JOIN {{SCHEMA}}.OACT f ON f."AcctCode" = a."FatherNum"
  WHERE a."Postable" = 'Y'
    AND f."AcctName" IN ('BANK ACCOUNTS','PAYMENT BANK ONLINE','CASH IN HAND',
                         'BANK CASH CREDIT LOAN','FDR','TERM LOAN',
                         'VEHICLE LOAN','CREDIT CARD')
),

-- ---- DSC1 house-bank row, where one exists (0-5 per book) --------------------
house AS (
  SELECT d."GLAccount"                              AS GL,
         MIN(d."BankCode")                          AS BANKCODE,
         MIN(d."Account")                           AS ACCTNO,
         MIN(REPLACE_REGEXPR('[^0-9]' IN d."Account" WITH '' OCCURRENCE ALL))
                                                    AS ACCTNO_DIGITS,
         MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(d."BranchName", d."Branch")), '')) AS BRANCH
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.DSC1 d
  WHERE d."GLAccount" IS NOT NULL AND d."GLAccount" <> ''
  GROUP BY d."GLAccount"
),

-- ---- canonical bank name: ODSC master, matched on BankName or a >=4 char code
bankmatch AS (
  SELECT GL, BANKCODE, BANKNAME FROM (
    SELECT u.GL                                      AS GL,
           o."BankCode"                              AS BANKCODE,
           o."BankName"                              AS BANKNAME,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.GL
                              ORDER BY LENGTH(o."BankName") DESC,
                                       o."BankCode")  AS RN
    FROM univ u
    JOIN {{SCHEMA}}.ODSC o
      ON  UPPER(u.GLNAME) LIKE '%'||UPPER(o."BankName")||'%'
      OR (LENGTH(o."BankCode") >= 4
          AND UPPER(u.GLNAME) LIKE '%'||UPPER(o."BankCode")||'%')
  ) WHERE RN = 1
),

-- ---- CANCELLED / REVERSED transactions (see TRAP 5 in the header) ------------
-- Both halves of every storno pair: the reversing journal AND the journal it
-- reverses.  OJDT."StornoToTr" is doc-type agnostic, so this one set covers
-- cancelled incoming payments, cancelled outgoing payments and reversed manual
-- journal entries alike.
storno AS (
  SELECT "TransId"    AS T FROM {{SCHEMA}}.OJDT
   WHERE "StornoToTr" IS NOT NULL AND "StornoToTr" <> 0
  UNION
  SELECT "StornoToTr" AS T FROM {{SCHEMA}}.OJDT
   WHERE "StornoToTr" IS NOT NULL AND "StornoToTr" <> 0
),

-- ---- JIVO group / branch counterparties (see TRAP 6) -------------------------
-- Two tests, because neither alone is enough: the branch GROUP catches the
-- BRANCH CUSTOMER / BRANCH VENDOR families, and the NAME catches the group
-- companies filed in an ordinary trade group (Mart's VENDA000001 'JIVO WELLNESS
-- PVT LTD' sits in group 106 PURCHASE).  Verified to cover all 23 known group
-- CardCodes in all three books without dragging in a real third party.
grpbp AS (
  SELECT c."CardCode" AS CC
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.OCRD c
  LEFT JOIN {{SCHEMA}}.OCRG g
    ON g."GroupCode" = c."GroupCode" AND g."GroupType" = c."CardType"
  WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(g."GroupName",'')) LIKE '%BRANCH%'
     OR UPPER(COALESCE(c."CardName" ,'')) LIKE '%JIVO%'
),
-- DISTINCT is load-bearing: without it this left join would fan the ledger out.
grptx AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT j."TransId" AS T
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.JDT1 j
  WHERE j."ShortName" IN (SELECT CC FROM grpbp)
),

-- ---- the twelve month slots of the window (dense, zero-filled later) ---------
mslot AS (
  SELECT 0 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 1  FROM DUMMY UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 3  FROM DUMMY UNION ALL
  SELECT 4 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 5  FROM DUMMY UNION ALL
  SELECT 6 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 7  FROM DUMMY UNION ALL
  SELECT 8 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 9  FROM DUMMY UNION ALL
  SELECT 10 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 11 FROM DUMMY
),
months AS (
  SELECT TO_VARCHAR(ADD_MONTHS(p.WSTART, s.N), 'YYYY-MM') AS M
  FROM params p CROSS JOIN mslot s
),

-- ---- when this book's banking ledger opens, and each account's opening -------
openday AS (
  -- Gated by the as-of: without it, a position taken BEFORE the book opened
  -- reports a future opening balance against a nil closing balance (measured on
  -- Mart at --as-of 2024-11-30: 80.03 L of "opening" on a book that opens
  -- 2024-12-31).  NULL here simply zeroes every OPENING_BAL_L.
  SELECT MIN(j."RefDate") AS OPEN_D
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.JDT1 j
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE j."Account" IN (SELECT GL FROM univ)
    AND j."RefDate" <= p.ASOF
),

-- ---- ledger position and lifetime footprint ---------------------------------
bal AS (
  SELECT j."Account"                                                        AS GL,
         SUM(CASE WHEN j."RefDate" <= p.ASOF
                  THEN CAST(j."Debit" AS DOUBLE) - CAST(j."Credit" AS DOUBLE)
                  ELSE 0 END)                                               AS BAL,
         SUM(CASE WHEN j."RefDate" = o.OPEN_D
                  THEN CAST(j."Debit" AS DOUBLE) - CAST(j."Credit" AS DOUBLE)
                  ELSE 0 END)                                               AS OPENING,
         -- ...but FIRST/LAST MOVEMENT are about REAL traffic, so a cancelled
         -- payment and its reversal must not make a dead account look alive.
         MIN(CASE WHEN j."RefDate" <= p.ASOF AND st.T IS NULL
                  THEN j."RefDate" END)                                     AS FIRSTMV,
         MAX(CASE WHEN j."RefDate" <= p.ASOF AND st.T IS NULL
                  THEN j."RefDate" END)                                     AS LASTMV
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.JDT1 j
  CROSS JOIN params p
  CROSS JOIN openday o
  LEFT JOIN storno st ON st.T = j."TransId"
  WHERE j."Account" IN (SELECT GL FROM univ)
  GROUP BY j."Account"
),

-- ---- movement, one row per account per month inside the 12-month window -----
mon AS (
  SELECT j."Account"                              AS GL,
         TO_VARCHAR(j."RefDate",'YYYY-MM')        AS M,
         -- st.T IS NULL  =  a line that was not cancelled and is not a reversal
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL THEN CAST(j."Debit"  AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS MIN_,
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL THEN CAST(j."Credit" AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS MOUT_,
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                          AS NL,
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL AND j."TransType" = '30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NJE,
         -- the churn that was removed, kept visible instead of vanishing
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(j."Debit" AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS MCANC,
         -- of the REAL traffic, how much sat in a transaction that also touched a
         -- JIVO group / branch party
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL AND gx.T IS NOT NULL
                  THEN CAST(j."Debit"  AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)                  AS MGIN,
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL AND gx.T IS NOT NULL
                  THEN CAST(j."Credit" AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)                  AS MGOUT
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.JDT1 j
  CROSS JOIN params p
  LEFT JOIN storno st ON st.T = j."TransId"
  LEFT JOIN grptx  gx ON gx.T = j."TransId"
  WHERE j."Account" IN (SELECT GL FROM univ)
    AND j."RefDate" >= p.WSTART
    AND j."RefDate" <= p.ASOF
  GROUP BY j."Account", TO_VARCHAR(j."RefDate",'YYYY-MM')
),
mv AS (
  SELECT GL,
         SUM(MIN_)   AS IN12,
         SUM(MOUT_)  AS OUT12,
         SUM(NL)     AS NL12,
         SUM(NJE)    AS NJE12,
         SUM(MCANC)  AS CANC12,
         SUM(MGIN)   AS GIN12,
         SUM(MGOUT)  AS GOUT12,
         -- months that actually moved: NL, not COUNT(*), or a month whose only
         -- traffic was a cancelled payment would still count as active.
         SUM(CASE WHEN NL > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ACTMON
  FROM mon
  GROUP BY GL
),
-- every account x every one of the 12 slots, zero where nothing moved
dense AS (
  SELECT u.GL                       AS GL,
         mo.M                       AS M,
         COALESCE(m.MIN_,  0)       AS DIN,
         COALESCE(m.MOUT_, 0)       AS DOUT
  FROM univ u
  CROSS JOIN months mo
  LEFT JOIN mon m ON m.GL = u.GL AND m.M = mo.M
),
ser AS (
  -- TRAP: CAST(<double> AS DECIMAL(n,2)) TRUNCATES in HANA - it does not round.
  -- ROUND(0.11507,2) is a double a hair under 0.12, and the cast then chops it to
  -- 0.11, so a naive series is biased DOWN by up to a paisa a month (measured:
  -- Oil 2201405 lost 0.09 L over 12 months against its own 12m total).  Rounding
  -- inside the DECIMAL domain - TO_DECIMAL first, ROUND second - is exact, and is
  -- what keeps MONTHLY_*_SERIES adding back to RECEIPTS_IN_12M_L /
  -- PAYMENTS_OUT_12M_L.  Residual measured after the storno fix: at most 0.02 L on
  -- any account in any book - twelve 2dp values cannot sum to a 2dp total exactly.
  SELECT GL,
         STRING_AGG(M||'='||TO_VARCHAR(CAST(ROUND(TO_DECIMAL(DIN /100000,28,6),2)
                                            AS DECIMAL(18,2))),
                    ';' ORDER BY M)                                    AS SER_IN,
         STRING_AGG(M||'='||TO_VARCHAR(CAST(ROUND(TO_DECIMAL(DOUT/100000,28,6),2)
                                            AS DECIMAL(18,2))),
                    ';' ORDER BY M)                                    AS SER_OUT,
         STRING_AGG(M||'='||TO_VARCHAR(CAST(ROUND(TO_DECIMAL((DIN-DOUT)/100000,28,6),2)
                                            AS DECIMAL(18,2))),
                    ';' ORDER BY M)                                    AS SER_NET
  FROM dense
  GROUP BY GL
),

-- ---- assemble ---------------------------------------------------------------
core AS (
  SELECT u.GL, u.GLNAME, u.DRAWER, u.CATEGORY, u.CATEGORY_KIND,
         u.IS_CASH_AND_BANK, u.CURRTOTAL, u.NAME_DIGITS,
         p.ASOF, p.CC_RATE, o.OPEN_D,
         COALESCE(b.BAL, 0)                                            AS BAL,
         COALESCE(b.OPENING, 0)                                        AS OPENING,
         b.FIRSTMV, b.LASTMV,
         COALESCE(m.IN12, 0)                                           AS IN12,
         COALESCE(m.OUT12, 0)                                          AS OUT12,
         COALESCE(m.NL12, 0)                                           AS NL12,
         COALESCE(m.NJE12, 0)                                          AS NJE12,
         COALESCE(m.ACTMON, 0)                                         AS ACTMON,
         COALESCE(m.CANC12, 0)                                         AS CANC12,
         COALESCE(m.GIN12, 0)                                          AS GIN12,
         COALESCE(m.GOUT12, 0)                                         AS GOUT12,
         s.SER_IN, s.SER_OUT, s.SER_NET,
         h.BANKCODE                                                    AS H_BANKCODE,
         h.ACCTNO                                                      AS H_ACCTNO,
         h.BRANCH                                                      AS H_BRANCH,
         -- does the DSC1 house-bank row actually describe THIS G/L account?
         CASE
           WHEN h.ACCTNO_DIGITS IS NULL OR h.ACCTNO_DIGITS = ''  THEN NULL
           WHEN u.NAME_DIGITS = ''                               THEN 'UNKNOWN'
           WHEN u.NAME_DIGITS LIKE '%'||h.ACCTNO_DIGITS||'%'
             OR h.ACCTNO_DIGITS LIKE '%'||u.NAME_DIGITS||'%'     THEN 'AGREE'
           ELSE 'MISMATCH'
         END                                                           AS H_AGREE,
         bm.BANKCODE                                                   AS O_BANKCODE,
         bm.BANKNAME                                                   AS O_BANKNAME
  FROM univ u
  CROSS JOIN params p
  CROSS JOIN openday o
  LEFT JOIN bal       b  ON b.GL  = u.GL
  LEFT JOIN mv        m  ON m.GL  = u.GL
  LEFT JOIN ser       s  ON s.GL  = u.GL
  LEFT JOIN house     h  ON h.GL  = u.GL
  LEFT JOIN bankmatch bm ON bm.GL = u.GL
)
SELECT
  '{{SCHEMA}}'                                                    AS COMPANY_SCHEMA,
  c.ASOF                                                          AS AS_OF,
  c.CATEGORY                                                      AS CATEGORY,
  c.CATEGORY_KIND                                                 AS CATEGORY_KIND,
  c.IS_CASH_AND_BANK                                              AS IS_CASH_AND_BANK,
  c.GL                                                            AS GL_ACCT_CODE,
  c.DRAWER                                                        AS GL_DRAWER,
  REPLACE_REGEXPR('[0-9]' IN c.GLNAME WITH 'x' OCCURRENCE ALL)    AS GL_ACCT_LABEL_MASKED,
  COALESCE(CASE WHEN c.H_AGREE = 'AGREE' THEN c.H_BANKCODE END,
           c.O_BANKCODE)                                          AS BANK_CODE,
  COALESCE(c.O_BANKNAME,
           CASE WHEN UPPER(c.GLNAME) LIKE '%BANK%'
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR_REGEXPR('^[A-Z& ]+' IN
                       REPLACE_REGEXPR('^(FDR|LOAN TERM|LOAN|TERM)[ .:-]*' IN
                                       UPPER(c.GLNAME) WITH ''))), '')
           END)                                                   AS BANK_NAME,
  CASE WHEN c.O_BANKNAME IS NOT NULL             THEN 'ODSC_MASTER'
       WHEN UPPER(c.GLNAME) LIKE '%BANK%'
        AND TRIM(SUBSTR_REGEXPR('^[A-Z& ]+' IN
              REPLACE_REGEXPR('^(FDR|LOAN TERM|LOAN|TERM)[ .:-]*' IN
                              UPPER(c.GLNAME) WITH ''))) <> ''    THEN 'GL_ACCT_NAME'
       ELSE 'UNRESOLVED' END                                      AS BANK_NAME_SOURCE,
  CASE WHEN c.H_AGREE = 'AGREE' THEN c.H_BRANCH END                AS BRANCH,
  CASE WHEN c.H_ACCTNO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END          AS IS_HOUSE_BANK,
  COALESCE(c.H_AGREE, 'NO_HOUSE_BANK_ROW')                        AS HOUSE_BANK_AGREES,
  CASE
    WHEN c.H_AGREE = 'AGREE' AND LENGTH(c.H_ACCTNO) >= 4
      THEN 'xxxx'||RIGHT(c.H_ACCTNO, 4)
    WHEN LENGTH(c.NAME_DIGITS) >= 4
      THEN 'xxxx'||RIGHT(c.NAME_DIGITS, 4)
    ELSE NULL
  END                                                             AS ACCT_NO_MASKED,
  CASE
    WHEN c.H_AGREE = 'AGREE' AND LENGTH(c.H_ACCTNO) >= 4 THEN 'DSC1_HOUSE_BANK'
    WHEN LENGTH(c.NAME_DIGITS) >= 4                      THEN 'GL_ACCT_NAME'
    ELSE 'NONE'
  END                                                             AS ACCT_NO_SOURCE,
  CASE
    WHEN c.H_AGREE = 'AGREE' AND LENGTH(c.H_ACCTNO) >= 4
      THEN LENGTH(REPLACE_REGEXPR('[^0-9]' IN c.H_ACCTNO WITH '' OCCURRENCE ALL))
    ELSE LENGTH(c.NAME_DIGITS)
  END                                                             AS ACCT_NO_NDIGITS,

  ROUND(c.BAL       / 100000, 2)                                  AS BALANCE_L,
  ROUND(c.CURRTOTAL / 100000, 2)                                  AS CURRTOTAL_TODAY_L,
  CASE WHEN ROUND(c.BAL,2) > 0 THEN 'DEBIT'
       WHEN ROUND(c.BAL,2) < 0 THEN 'CREDIT'
       ELSE 'NIL' END                                             AS BALANCE_SIGN,
  ROUND(CASE WHEN c.BAL > 0 THEN c.BAL ELSE 0 END / 100000, 2)    AS FUNDS_AVAILABLE_L,
  ROUND(CASE WHEN c.BAL < 0 THEN -c.BAL ELSE 0 END / 100000, 2)   AS AMOUNT_DRAWN_L,
  -- an asset-side account in credit is a genuine overdraw / booking error;
  -- a CC/OD or loan account in credit is simply borrowing, and is NOT flagged.
  CASE WHEN c.CATEGORY IN ('CURRENT_ACCOUNT','PAYMENT_WALLET','CASH_IN_HAND',
                           'FIXED_DEPOSIT')
             AND c.BAL < -100 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END               AS OVERDRAWN_FLAG,
  CASE WHEN c.CATEGORY_KIND = 'BORROWING' OR c.CATEGORY = 'CASH_CREDIT_OD'
       THEN ROUND((CASE WHEN c.BAL < 0 THEN -c.BAL ELSE 0 END) * c.CC_RATE / 100000, 2)
       ELSE 0 END                                                 AS EST_ANNUAL_INTEREST_L,

  ROUND(c.IN12  / 100000, 2)                                      AS RECEIPTS_IN_12M_L,
  ROUND(c.OUT12 / 100000, 2)                                      AS PAYMENTS_OUT_12M_L,
  ROUND((c.IN12 - c.OUT12) / 100000, 2)                           AS NET_12M_L,
  ROUND(c.OUT12 / (CASE WHEN c.ACTMON = 0 THEN 1 ELSE c.ACTMON END) / 100000, 2)
                                                                  AS AVG_MONTHLY_OUT_L,
  ROUND(c.CANC12 / 100000, 2)                                     AS CANCELLED_GROSS_12M_L,
  ROUND(c.GIN12   / 100000, 2)                                    AS INTERCO_IN_12M_L,
  ROUND(c.GOUT12  / 100000, 2)                                    AS INTERCO_OUT_12M_L,
  c.NL12                                                          AS N_LINES_12M,
  c.ACTMON                                                        AS ACTIVE_MONTHS_12M,
  CASE WHEN c.NL12 = 0 THEN NULL
       ELSE CAST(ROUND(TO_DECIMAL(100.0 * c.NJE12 / c.NL12, 28, 6), 1) AS DECIMAL(5,1))
  END                                                             AS MANUAL_JE_LINE_PCT_12M,

  TO_VARCHAR(c.FIRSTMV, 'YYYY-MM-DD')                             AS FIRST_MOVE_DATE,
  TO_VARCHAR(c.LASTMV,  'YYYY-MM-DD')                             AS LAST_MOVE_DATE,
  CASE WHEN c.LASTMV IS NULL THEN NULL
       ELSE DAYS_BETWEEN(c.LASTMV, c.ASOF) END                    AS DAYS_SINCE_LAST_MOVE,
  CASE WHEN c.LASTMV IS NULL THEN 'Y'
       WHEN DAYS_BETWEEN(c.LASTMV, c.ASOF) >= 90 THEN 'Y'
       ELSE 'N' END                                               AS DORMANT_90D_FLAG,
  CASE WHEN c.FIRSTMV IS NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END               AS NEVER_USED_FLAG,
  TO_VARCHAR(c.OPEN_D, 'YYYY-MM-DD')                              AS BOOK_OPENING_DATE,
  ROUND(c.OPENING / 100000, 2)                                    AS OPENING_BAL_L,

  c.SER_IN                                                        AS MONTHLY_IN_L_SERIES,
  c.SER_OUT                                                       AS MONTHLY_OUT_L_SERIES,
  c.SER_NET                                                       AS MONTHLY_NET_L_SERIES,

  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.IS_CASH_AND_BANK = 'Y' THEN c.BAL ELSE 0 END)
        OVER () / 100000, 2)                                      AS TOT_CASH_AND_BANK_L,

terms.label: Current accounts + wallets + cash
terms.note: Oil -5.02 L

terms.label: Cash credit / overdraft, NET
terms.note: Oil -3,760.04 L - this is what makes the headline negative

terms.label: 'Cash and bank'
terms.note: a treasury net position, NOT cash. Never label it 'cash'

check.method: reproduces the figure measured independently from the SQL when the section was catalogued

bank-cc-od-drawn.closure_note: Terms describe how the query built this figure; they are not addends over a row set, so no arithmetic closure is asserted.

excludes.label: Term, vehicle and card debt
excludes.why: carried in TOT_BORROWINGS_L; adding TOT_CC_OD_NET_L to TOT_BORROWINGS_L double counts the overdraft

bank-cc-od-drawn.formula: ABS(TOT_CC_OD_NET_L) x 1e5. NET across the CC/OD drawer - drawn accounts less the two Oil facilities sitting in debit - which is why it (3,760.04 L) is smaller than the drawer's gross drawn (5,251.23 L).
bank-cc-od-drawn.label: Drawn on cash credit and overdraft
bank-cc-od-drawn.method: direct + sign flip (the column stores this as a credit)

rows.filter: True   # one-company slice, so agg='first' takes exactly ONE row. If the three slices are ever concatenated, de-duplicate on COMPANY_SCHEMA before taking first, exactly as site/index.html:1595 does.

section_traps: BROADCAST COLUMNS. The seven TOT_* columns are company-level window totals (SUM(...) OVER (), sql lines 614-628) repeated IDENTICALLY on every row. Summing one across rows multiplies it by the row count: Oil's TOT_BORROWINGS_L summed over 70 rows gives 601,615 L = Rs 6,016 Cr against a true Rs 85.95 Cr. Every TOT_* KPI must use agg='first' on one row per company, and a concatenated multi-company array must be de-duplicated on COMPANY_SCHEMA first (site/index.html:1595 does exactly this).

The seven TOT_* columns are NOT DISJOINT and must never be added together. TOT_CASH_AND_BANK_L already contains TOT_BANK_CURRENT_L + TOT_CASH_IN_HAND_L + TOT_WALLET_L + TOT_CC_OD_NET_L, and TOT_BORROWINGS_L (gross drawn) overlaps TOT_CC_OD_NET_L (net). Read ONE per question. The per-account columns, by contrast, ARE safe to sum: one row per G/L account, no fan-out, no faceting.

'Cash and bank' is not cash. TOT_CASH_AND_BANK_L includes the drawn overdraft, so Oil's is -3,765.06 L = MINUS Rs 37.65 Cr. The hero card deliberately publishes 'Net bank position' = current + cash + wallets + deposits - abs(borrowings) instead, because JIVO holds almost nothing in current accounts and funds itself on cash credit: a cash-and-bank headline would read as liquidity the business does not have. Oil's real net position is -Rs 74.86 Cr. Keep that reasoning attached to the number wherever it is shown.

Oil's liquid position is NEGATIVE: -5.02 L across current accounts, wallets and cash. Of that, cash in hand is -10.12 L because 1105001 CASH SALE sits at -10.23 L - a till in CREDIT, which cannot physically happen. ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN c.CATEGORY = 'CASH_CREDIT_OD' THEN c.BAL ELSE 0 END)
        OVER () / 100000, 2)                                      AS TOT_CC_OD_NET_L,

terms.label: CC / OD accounts, net
terms.note: SIGN: the column is NEGATIVE when drawn. abs() before display or the bar points the wrong way

check.method: reproduces the figure measured independently from the SQL when the section was catalogued

excludes.label: Sub-Rs 1,000 balances

The test is OCRG.GroupName LIKE '%BRANCH%' OR OCRD.CardName LIKE '%JIVO%' - the group test alone misses Mart's largest payable VENDA000001 'JIVO WELLNESS PVT LTD', which sits in an ordinary PURCHASE group, and the 23 known group CardCodes (C-0005) are book-specific and cannot be hardcoded across three schemas.

EST_ANNUAL_INTEREST_L is an INPUT CONSTANT (8.47%, sql line 255) applied to TODAY's drawn balance - not an accrual, not a measured cost, and not comparable with the P&L. Oil's 727.97 L sits about 57% above the 463.37 L actually debited to 5610001 INTEREST ON BANK LOAN over the same twelve months (measured 2026-08-21, ~7.53% gross on an average drawn 6,148.65 L). Some borrowing cost also sits on other accounts (2163024 TRADEPAY interest payable, 2163026 term-loan interest payable). Present it as an upper-bound run-rate, never as interest paid.

AVG_MONTHLY_OUT_L divides by ACTIVE months, not by 12 - deliberately, so a seasonal account is not flattered. The cost: Oil 2201211 reads 1,500.00 L 'per month' off a single Rs 15 Cr term-loan repayment in one active month. Never annualise it by x12, and never rank accounts on it.

MANUAL_JE_LINE_PCT_12M is a share of LINES, not of value, and it is NULL - not 0 - where the account had no 12-month traffic (Oil 14 / Mart 33 / Bev 12 rows). It reads 100.0 on any account with a single line, so an unweighted average is meaningless: measured 45.6% unweighted against 5.4% line-weighted in Oil. Only three TransTypes ever touch these accounts (24 incoming, 46 outgoing, 30 manual JE); no invoice posts to a bank account directly.

CURRTOTAL_TODAY_L is a LIFETIME balance and is NOT filtered by as_of. It equals BALANCE_L exactly on all 132 rows today, which is what makes it a valid independent cross-check - but any historical as-of run will make it legitimately disagree, and the check dot must then read 'not applicable at this as-of', not red. Beverages' JDT1 does hold lines out to 2026-12-31, so the <= as_of guard is not decorative.

ROUNDING IS COARSE AND ASYMMETRIC. Every _L column is ROUND(x/1e5, 2) = Rs 1,000 granularity, and the TOT_* window totals round AFTER summing in rupees while a per-row sum rounds first. Live deltas today: Oil cash-in-hand -0.01 L, fixed deposits +0.01 L, borrowings -0.01 L. The monthly series adds back to the 12-month totals within 0.02 L per account (HANA's CAST(double AS DECIMAL) TRUNCATES, so the SQL rounds inside the DECIMAL domain). Every check needs a Rs 1,000 x rowcount tolerance; exact equality WILL false-alarm.

BOOK_OPENING_DATE is DERIVED per book, never hardcoded to the 2024-09-30 go-live: MART'S BANKING LEDGER OPENS 2024-12-31, with nothing before it. A hardcoded go-live returns 0 for every Mart account. OPENING_BAL_L is gated by as_of after a fix on 2026-08-21 - before it, an as-of BEFORE the book opened reported a FUTURE opening balance (measured: Mart at --as-of 2024-11-30 showed 80.03 L of opening against a nil closing balance). Beverages has 0.00 opening on all 18 rows, a measured nil.

THERE IS NO DETAIL SLICE. detail is [] in all three books, so no page may offer a drill to individual JDT1 lines, a payment list, a cheque number or a statement view. gl-account.html for a bank account can show only the 51 summary columns for that account, its three monthly series, and its history.jsonl trend. Whether the G/L position agrees with what the bank says is bank-reco's job (OBNK), not this section's - this section never touches OBNK.

THERE IS NO FACILITY LIMIT ANYWHERE IN THIS DATA. Sanctioned limits, drawing power and margin are not in ODSC, DSC1 or OACT, so 'headroom', '% of limit used' and 'available credit' cannot be computed here and must not be implied by a gauge, a progress bar or a phrase like 'available'. FUNDS_AVAILABLE_L is a debit balance, not a credit line.

This is a G/L register, not a party or document register - no CardCode, no DocEntry, no DocStatus, so C-0019 / C-0021's document half do not bite here. What does bite: these figures cannot be added to any other section. Bank movement is not turnover, INTERCO_* overlaps whatever the ageing sections flag as intercompany, and 'total liabilities = payables + provisions + borrowings' is not a supported sum.

ACCOUNT NUMBERS ARE SENSITIVE AND ARE NEVER EMITTED IN FULL. They live INSIDE OACT.AcctName, so the raw account name never leaves the query: GL_ACCT_LABEL_MASKED x's every digit and ACCT_NO_MASKED is 'xxxx' + last 4. Never join this section back to OACT.AcctName to 'improve' a label, never widen the mask, and never treat ACCT_NO_MASKED NULL (9 Oil / 6 Mart / 5 Bev rows) as an error - it means the books hold fewer than four digits for that account. GL_ACCT_CODE is a chart code, not a bank account number, and is safe.

sql.text:
0.0847                                                                AS CC_RATE
  FROM DUMMY
),

-- ---- the account universe, defined by the PARENT DRAWER NAME -----------------
univ AS (
  SELECT a."AcctCode"                                    AS GL,
         a."AcctName"                                    AS GLNAME,
         f."AcctName"                                    AS DRAWER,
         CAST(a."CurrTotal" AS DOUBLE)                   AS CURRTOTAL,
         CASE f."AcctName"
           WHEN 'BANK ACCOUNTS'         THEN 'CURRENT_ACCOUNT'
           WHEN 'PAYMENT BANK ONLINE'   THEN 'PAYMENT_WALLET'
           WHEN 'CASH IN HAND'          THEN 'CASH_IN_HAND'
           WHEN 'BANK CASH CREDIT LOAN' THEN 'CASH_CREDIT_OD'
           WHEN 'FDR'                   THEN 'FIXED_DEPOSIT'
           WHEN 'TERM LOAN'             THEN 'TERM_LOAN'
           WHEN 'VEHICLE LOAN'          THEN 'VEHICLE_LOAN'
           WHEN 'CREDIT CARD'           THEN 'CREDIT_CARD'
         END                                             AS CATEGORY,
         CASE f."AcctName"
           WHEN 'BANK ACCOUNTS'         THEN 'BANK'
           WHEN 'PAYMENT BANK ONLINE'   THEN 'BANK'
           WHEN 'CASH IN HAND'          THEN 'CASH'
           WHEN 'BANK CASH CREDIT LOAN' THEN 'BANK'
           WHEN 'FDR'                   THEN 'DEPOSIT'
           ELSE 'BORROWING'
         END                                             AS CATEGORY_KIND,
         -- what counts towards the cash-and-bank position
         CASE WHEN f."AcctName" IN ('BANK ACCOUNTS','PAYMENT BANK ONLINE',
                                    'CASH IN HAND','BANK CASH CREDIT LOAN')
              THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END                      AS IS_CASH_AND_BANK,
         -- digits embedded in the account name (the bank account number)
         REPLACE_REGEXPR('[^0-9]' IN a."AcctName" WITH '' OCCURRENCE ALL)
                                                         AS NAME_DIGITS
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.OACT a
  JOIN {{SCHEMA}}.OACT f ON f."AcctCode" = a."FatherNum"
  WHERE a."Postable" = 'Y'
    AND f."AcctName" IN ('BANK ACCOUNTS','PAYMENT BANK ONLINE','CASH IN HAND',
                         'BANK CASH CREDIT LOAN','FDR','TERM LOAN',
                         'VEHICLE LOAN','CREDIT CARD')
),

-- ---- DSC1 house-bank row, where one exists (0-5 per book) --------------------
house AS (
  SELECT d."GLAccount"                              AS GL,
         MIN(d."BankCode")                          AS BANKCODE,
         MIN(d."Account")                           AS ACCTNO,
         MIN(REPLACE_REGEXPR('[^0-9]' IN d."Account" WITH '' OCCURRENCE ALL))
                                                    AS ACCTNO_DIGITS,
         MIN(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(d."BranchName", d."Branch")), '')) AS BRANCH
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.DSC1 d
  WHERE d."GLAccount" IS NOT NULL AND d."GLAccount" <> ''
  GROUP BY d."GLAccount"
),

-- ---- canonical bank name: ODSC master, matched on BankName or a >=4 char code
bankmatch AS (
  SELECT GL, BANKCODE, BANKNAME FROM (
    SELECT u.GL                                      AS GL,
           o."BankCode"                              AS BANKCODE,
           o."BankName"                              AS BANKNAME,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY u.GL
                              ORDER BY LENGTH(o."BankName") DESC,
                                       o."BankCode")  AS RN
    FROM univ u
    JOIN {{SCHEMA}}.ODSC o
      ON  UPPER(u.GLNAME) LIKE '%'||UPPER(o."BankName")||'%'
      OR (LENGTH(o."BankCode") >= 4
          AND UPPER(u.GLNAME) LIKE '%'||UPPER(o."BankCode")||'%')
  ) WHERE RN = 1
),

-- ---- CANCELLED / REVERSED transactions (see TRAP 5 in the header) ------------
-- Both halves of every storno pair: the reversing journal AND the journal it
-- reverses.  OJDT."StornoToTr" is doc-type agnostic, so this one set covers
-- cancelled incoming payments, cancelled outgoing payments and reversed manual
-- journal entries alike.
storno AS (
  SELECT "TransId"    AS T FROM {{SCHEMA}}.OJDT
   WHERE "StornoToTr" IS NOT NULL AND "StornoToTr" <> 0
  UNION
  SELECT "StornoToTr" AS T FROM {{SCHEMA}}.OJDT
   WHERE "StornoToTr" IS NOT NULL AND "StornoToTr" <> 0
),

-- ---- JIVO group / branch counterparties (see TRAP 6) -------------------------
-- Two tests, because neither alone is enough: the branch GROUP catches the
-- BRANCH CUSTOMER / BRANCH VENDOR families, and the NAME catches the group
-- companies filed in an ordinary trade group (Mart's VENDA000001 'JIVO WELLNESS
-- PVT LTD' sits in group 106 PURCHASE).  Verified to cover all 23 known group
-- CardCodes in all three books without dragging in a real third party.
grpbp AS (
  SELECT c."CardCode" AS CC
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.OCRD c
  LEFT JOIN {{SCHEMA}}.OCRG g
    ON g."GroupCode" = c."GroupCode" AND g."GroupType" = c."CardType"
  WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(g."GroupName",'')) LIKE '%BRANCH%'
     OR UPPER(COALESCE(c."CardName" ,'')) LIKE '%JIVO%'
),
-- DISTINCT is load-bearing: without it this left join would fan the ledger out.
grptx AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT j."TransId" AS T
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.JDT1 j
  WHERE j."ShortName" IN (SELECT CC FROM grpbp)
),

-- ---- the twelve month slots of the window (dense, zero-filled later) ---------
mslot AS (
  SELECT 0 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 1  FROM DUMMY UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 3  FROM DUMMY UNION ALL
  SELECT 4 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 5  FROM DUMMY UNION ALL
  SELECT 6 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 7  FROM DUMMY UNION ALL
  SELECT 8 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 9  FROM DUMMY UNION ALL
  SELECT 10 AS N FROM DUMMY UNION ALL SELECT 11 FROM DUMMY
),
months AS (
  SELECT TO_VARCHAR(ADD_MONTHS(p.WSTART, s.N), 'YYYY-MM') AS M
  FROM params p CROSS JOIN mslot s
),

-- ---- when this book's banking ledger opens, and each account's opening -------
openday AS (
  -- Gated by the as-of: without it, a position taken BEFORE the book opened
  -- reports a future opening balance against a nil closing balance (measured on
  -- Mart at --as-of 2024-11-30: 80.03 L of "opening" on a book that opens
  -- 2024-12-31).  NULL here simply zeroes every OPENING_BAL_L.
  SELECT MIN(j."RefDate") AS OPEN_D
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.JDT1 j
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE j."Account" IN (SELECT GL FROM univ)
    AND j."RefDate" <= p.ASOF
),

-- ---- ledger position and lifetime footprint ---------------------------------
bal AS (
  SELECT j."Account"                                                        AS GL,
         SUM(CASE WHEN j."RefDate" <= p.ASOF
                  THEN CAST(j."Debit" AS DOUBLE) - CAST(j."Credit" AS DOUBLE)
                  ELSE 0 END)                                               AS BAL,
         SUM(CASE WHEN j."RefDate" = o.OPEN_D
                  THEN CAST(j."Debit" AS DOUBLE) - CAST(j."Credit" AS DOUBLE)
                  ELSE 0 END)                                               AS OPENING,
         -- ...but FIRST/LAST MOVEMENT are about REAL traffic, so a cancelled
         -- payment and its reversal must not make a dead account look alive.
         MIN(CASE WHEN j."RefDate" <= p.ASOF AND st.T IS NULL
                  THEN j."RefDate" END)                                     AS FIRSTMV,
         MAX(CASE WHEN j."RefDate" <= p.ASOF AND st.T IS NULL
                  THEN j."RefDate" END)                                     AS LASTMV
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.JDT1 j
  CROSS JOIN params p
  CROSS JOIN openday o
  LEFT JOIN storno st ON st.T = j."TransId"
  WHERE j."Account" IN (SELECT GL FROM univ)
  GROUP BY j."Account"
),

-- ---- movement, one row per account per month inside the 12-month window -----
mon AS (
  SELECT j."Account"                              AS GL,
         TO_VARCHAR(j."RefDate",'YYYY-MM')        AS M,
         -- st.T IS NULL  =  a line that was not cancelled and is not a reversal
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL THEN CAST(j."Debit"  AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS MIN_,
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL THEN CAST(j."Credit" AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS MOUT_,
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                          AS NL,
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL AND j."TransType" = '30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NJE,
         -- the churn that was removed, kept visible instead of vanishing
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(j."Debit" AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END) AS MCANC,
         -- of the REAL traffic, how much sat in a transaction that also touched a
         -- JIVO group / branch party
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL AND gx.T IS NOT NULL
                  THEN CAST(j."Debit"  AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)                  AS MGIN,
         SUM(CASE WHEN st.T IS NULL AND gx.T IS NOT NULL
                  THEN CAST(j."Credit" AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)                  AS MGOUT
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.JDT1 j
  CROSS JOIN params p
  LEFT JOIN storno st ON st.T = j."TransId"
  LEFT JOIN grptx  gx ON gx.T = j."TransId"
  WHERE j."Account" IN (SELECT GL FROM univ)
    AND j."RefDate" >= p.WSTART
    AND j."RefDate" <= p.ASOF
  GROUP BY j."Account", TO_VARCHAR(j."RefDate",'YYYY-MM')
),
mv AS (
  SELECT GL,
         SUM(MIN_)   AS IN12,
         SUM(MOUT_)  AS OUT12,
         SUM(NL)     AS NL12,
         SUM(NJE)    AS NJE12,
         SUM(MCANC)  AS CANC12,
         SUM(MGIN)   AS GIN12,
         SUM(MGOUT)  AS GOUT12,
         -- months that actually moved: NL, not COUNT(*), or a month whose only
         -- traffic was a cancelled payment would still count as active.
         SUM(CASE WHEN NL > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ACTMON
  FROM mon
  GROUP BY GL
),
-- every account x every one of the 12 slots, zero where nothing moved
dense AS (
  SELECT u.GL                       AS GL,
         mo.M                       AS M,
         COALESCE(m.MIN_,  0)       AS DIN,
         COALESCE(m.MOUT_, 0)       AS DOUT
  FROM univ u
  CROSS JOIN months mo
  LEFT JOIN mon m ON m.GL = u.GL AND m.M = mo.M
),
ser AS (
  -- TRAP: CAST(<double> AS DECIMAL(n,2)) TRUNCATES in HANA - it does not round.
  -- ROUND(0.11507,2) is a double a hair under 0.12, and the cast then chops it to
  -- 0.11, so a naive series is biased DOWN by up to a paisa a month (measured:
  -- Oil 2201405 lost 0.09 L over 12 months against its own 12m total).  Rounding
  -- inside the DECIMAL domain - TO_DECIMAL first, ROUND second - is exact, and is
  -- what keeps MONTHLY_*_SERIES adding back to RECEIPTS_IN_12M_L /
  -- PAYMENTS_OUT_12M_L.  Residual measured after the storno fix: at most 0.02 L on
  -- any account in any book - twelve 2dp values cannot sum to a 2dp total exactly.
  SELECT GL,
         STRING_AGG(M||'='||TO_VARCHAR(CAST(ROUND(TO_DECIMAL(DIN /100000,28,6),2)
                                            AS DECIMAL(18,2))),
                    ';' ORDER BY M)                                    AS SER_IN,
         STRING_AGG(M||'='||TO_VARCHAR(CAST(ROUND(TO_DECIMAL(DOUT/100000,28,6),2)
                                            AS DECIMAL(18,2))),
                    ';' ORDER BY M)                                    AS SER_OUT,
         STRING_AGG(M||'='||TO_VARCHAR(CAST(ROUND(TO_DECIMAL((DIN-DOUT)/100000,28,6),2)
                                            AS DECIMAL(18,2))),
                    ';' ORDER BY M)                                    AS SER_NET
  FROM dense
  GROUP BY GL
),

-- ---- assemble ---------------------------------------------------------------
core AS (
  SELECT u.GL, u.GLNAME, u.DRAWER, u.CATEGORY, u.CATEGORY_KIND,
         u.IS_CASH_AND_BANK, u.CURRTOTAL, u.NAME_DIGITS,
         p.ASOF, p.CC_RATE, o.OPEN_D,
         COALESCE(b.BAL, 0)                                            AS BAL,
         COALESCE(b.OPENING, 0)                                        AS OPENING,
         b.FIRSTMV, b.LASTMV,
         COALESCE(m.IN12, 0)                                           AS IN12,
         COALESCE(m.OUT12, 0)                                          AS OUT12,
         COALESCE(m.NL12, 0)                                           AS NL12,
         COALESCE(m.NJE12, 0)                                          AS NJE12,
         COALESCE(m.ACTMON, 0)                                         AS ACTMON,
         COALESCE(m.CANC12, 0)                                         AS CANC12,
         COALESCE(m.GIN12, 0)                                          AS GIN12,
         COALESCE(m.GOUT12, 0)                                         AS GOUT12,
         s.SER_IN, s.SER_OUT, s.SER_NET,
         h.BANKCODE                                                    AS H_BANKCODE,
         h.ACCTNO                                                      AS H_ACCTNO,
         h.BRANCH                                                      AS H_BRANCH,
         -- does the DSC1 house-bank row actually describe THIS G/L account?
         CASE
           WHEN h.ACCTNO_DIGITS IS NULL OR h.ACCTNO_DIGITS = ''  THEN NULL
           WHEN u.NAME_DIGITS = ''                               THEN 'UNKNOWN'
           WHEN u.NAME_DIGITS LIKE '%'||h.ACCTNO_DIGITS||'%'
             OR h.ACCTNO_DIGITS LIKE '%'||u.NAME_DIGITS||'%'     THEN 'AGREE'
           ELSE 'MISMATCH'
         END                                                           AS H_AGREE,
         bm.BANKCODE                                                   AS O_BANKCODE,
         bm.BANKNAME                                                   AS O_BANKNAME
  FROM univ u
  CROSS JOIN params p
  CROSS JOIN openday o
  LEFT JOIN bal       b  ON b.GL  = u.GL
  LEFT JOIN mv        m  ON m.GL  = u.GL
  LEFT JOIN ser       s  ON s.GL  = u.GL
  LEFT JOIN house     h  ON h.GL  = u.GL
  LEFT JOIN bankmatch bm ON bm.GL = u.GL
)
SELECT
  '{{SCHEMA}}'                                                    AS COMPANY_SCHEMA,
  c.ASOF                                                          AS AS_OF,
  c.CATEGORY                                                      AS CATEGORY,
  c.CATEGORY_KIND                                                 AS CATEGORY_KIND,
  c.IS_CASH_AND_BANK                                              AS IS_CASH_AND_BANK,
  c.GL                                                            AS GL_ACCT_CODE,
  c.DRAWER                                                        AS GL_DRAWER,
  REPLACE_REGEXPR('[0-9]' IN c.GLNAME WITH 'x' OCCURRENCE ALL)    AS GL_ACCT_LABEL_MASKED,
  COALESCE(CASE WHEN c.H_AGREE = 'AGREE' THEN c.H_BANKCODE END,
           c.O_BANKCODE)                                          AS BANK_CODE,
  COALESCE(c.O_BANKNAME,
           CASE WHEN UPPER(c.GLNAME) LIKE '%BANK%'
                THEN NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTR_REGEXPR('^[A-Z& ]+' IN
                       REPLACE_REGEXPR('^(FDR|LOAN TERM|LOAN|TERM)[ .:-]*' IN
                                       UPPER(c.GLNAME) WITH ''))), '')
           END)                                                   AS BANK_NAME,
  CASE WHEN c.O_BANKNAME IS NOT NULL             THEN 'ODSC_MASTER'
       WHEN UPPER(c.GLNAME) LIKE '%BANK%'
        AND TRIM(SUBSTR_REGEXPR('^[A-Z& ]+' IN
              REPLACE_REGEXPR('^(FDR|LOAN TERM|LOAN|TERM)[ .:-]*' IN
                              UPPER(c.GLNAME) WITH ''))) <> ''    THEN 'GL_ACCT_NAME'
       ELSE 'UNRESOLVED' END                                      AS BANK_NAME_SOURCE,
  CASE WHEN c.H_AGREE = 'AGREE' THEN c.H_BRANCH END                AS BRANCH,
  CASE WHEN c.H_ACCTNO IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END          AS IS_HOUSE_BANK,
  COALESCE(c.H_AGREE, 'NO_HOUSE_BANK_ROW')                        AS HOUSE_BANK_AGREES,
  CASE
    WHEN c.H_AGREE = 'AGREE' AND LENGTH(c.H_ACCTNO) >= 4
      THEN 'xxxx'||RIGHT(c.H_ACCTNO, 4)
    WHEN LENGTH(c.NAME_DIGITS) >= 4
      THEN 'xxxx'||RIGHT(c.NAME_DIGITS, 4)
    ELSE NULL
  END                                                             AS ACCT_NO_MASKED,
  CASE
    WHEN c.H_AGREE = 'AGREE' AND LENGTH(c.H_ACCTNO) >= 4 THEN 'DSC1_HOUSE_BANK'
    WHEN LENGTH(c.NAME_DIGITS) >= 4                      THEN 'GL_ACCT_NAME'
    ELSE 'NONE'
  END                                                             AS ACCT_NO_SOURCE,
  CASE
    WHEN c.H_AGREE = 'AGREE' AND LENGTH(c.H_ACCTNO) >= 4
      THEN LENGTH(REPLACE_REGEXPR('[^0-9]' IN c.H_ACCTNO WITH '' OCCURRENCE ALL))
    ELSE LENGTH(c.NAME_DIGITS)
  END                                                             AS ACCT_NO_NDIGITS,

  ROUND(c.BAL       / 100000, 2)                                  AS BALANCE_L,
  ROUND(c.CURRTOTAL / 100000, 2)                                  AS CURRTOTAL_TODAY_L,
  CASE WHEN ROUND(c.BAL,2) > 0 THEN 'DEBIT'
       WHEN ROUND(c.BAL,2) < 0 THEN 'CREDIT'
       ELSE 'NIL' END                                             AS BALANCE_SIGN,
  ROUND(CASE WHEN c.BAL > 0 THEN c.BAL ELSE 0 END / 100000, 2)    AS FUNDS_AVAILABLE_L,
  ROUND(CASE WHEN c.BAL < 0 THEN -c.BAL ELSE 0 END / 100000, 2)   AS AMOUNT_DRAWN_L,
  -- an asset-side account in credit is a genuine overdraw / booking error;
  -- a CC/OD or loan account in credit is simply borrowing, and is NOT flagged.
  CASE WHEN c.CATEGORY IN ('CURRENT_ACCOUNT','PAYMENT_WALLET','CASH_IN_HAND',
                           'FIXED_DEPOSIT')
             AND c.BAL < -100 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END               AS OVERDRAWN_FLAG,
  CASE WHEN c.CATEGORY_KIND = 'BORROWING' OR c.CATEGORY = 'CASH_CREDIT_OD'
       THEN ROUND((CASE WHEN c.BAL < 0 THEN -c.BAL ELSE 0 END) * c.CC_RATE / 100000, 2)
       ELSE 0 END                                                 AS EST_ANNUAL_INTEREST_L,

terms.note: Oil 8,594.49 L today

terms.label: Assumed rate 8.47%
terms.note: sql line 255; not measured, not per-facility, and not split between cheap term debt and dearer CC

terms.label: Estimated annual interest
