CLOSED_NOBILL_GROSS is not a liability (CLOSED_NOBILL_GROSS). Somebody closed the receipt and the bill never came - an audit item. Adding it to UNBILLED_GROSS to get 'total exposure' is wrong twice over: it is not owed, and NOINV_GROSS already counts those documents at their FULL value rather than at the offending lines.

NOINV_GROSS is not UNBILLED_GROSS (NOINV_GROSS, UNBILLED_GROSS). NOINV_* counts whole documents with no invoice anywhere at their full receipt value; UNBILLED_* counts only the offending LINES. Live Oil: 7.12 Cr against 6.48 Cr. They are different questions and the names do not say so.

PDN1.OpenQty is broken at JIVO (OpenQty) - it still equals Quantity on fully invoiced closed lines - and OpenInvQty is stated in the BASE UoM while Quantity is in the DOCUMENT UoM (oil RM factor 1098.9). Neither is used, and no quantity arithmetic exists anywhere in this section. Do not add one (C-0001).

Zero-quantity freight and expense lines never close by themselves (UB_ZEROQTY_LINES). A naive LineStatus='O' count overstates Oil's GR/IR by 18 documents. They are excluded by the live-invoice link, and the genuinely unbilled ones are reported separately - Oil 178 lines / 16.74 L, Mart 63 / 14.67 L, Bev 206 / 12.35 L. That value is INSIDE UNBILLED_GROSS; do not add it on top.

DOC_STATUS is display only (DOC_STATUS, OPDN.DocStatus). It disagrees with the lines in both directions - live today 2 Oil, 1 Mart and 3 Bev detail rows read 'C' yet are ROW_KIND='UNBILLED'. Open-ness is decided line by line, exactly as C-0019 requires for the A/R side.

OPEN_GROSS can exceed DOC_GROSS and that is correct (OPEN_GROSS, DOC_GROSS). On 166 of 456 Oil detail rows, 28 of 47 Mart and 213 of 285 Bev the header carries VatSum=0 while the lines carry tax, so DOC_GROSS is the NET receipt. DOC_* reconciles to the SAP screen; OPEN_* is the number to chase. Never 'fix' one to match the other.

Money is line-level throughout (PDN1.GTotal), never OPDN.DocTotal, so header freight (OPDN.TotalExpns, Oil ~9.50 L) is NOT in any figure on this page. Anyone reconciling this section to a header-total report will be out by the freight and by the hidden line tax in both directions.

RETURNED_DOCS / RETURNED_LINES / RETURNED_GROSS do not mean 'goods sent back' (RETURNED_GROSS). 96%+ of JIVO's goods returns are raised standalone with RPD1.BaseType=-1 and no GRPO link, so these columns are near-empty by construction (Oil 3 docs, Mart 1, Bev 0). Consequence: goods received, never billed and then returned standalone STAY in the GR/IR bucket. Upper bound by vendor overlap: Oil 43.50 L, Bev 0.83 L.

This is a TODAY dashboard (PDN1.LineStatus). LineStatus is a current-state flag with no history, so a historical --as-of run silently DROPS lines that were open then and have since been billed - measured at as-of 2026-05-31: Oil 143 docs / 67.69 L and Bev 165 / 8.81 L invisible. Never quote a month-end GR/IR provision from this section without saying so.

INTERNAL_ADJ and INTERCOMPANY are detected by CARD NAME (CardName LIKE 'STOCK GOODS%' and LIKE '%JIVO%'). A differently-named internal adjustment card would be classed EXTERNAL and would inflate EXT_UNBILLED_GROSS - the very number the headline quotes. Unresolved; worth a jivo-correct if Accounts knows the real rule.

GR/IR is NOT in the A/P ledger. By definition no vendor bill exists, so none of this appears in vendor-ageing / payables and it must never be reconciled against them. It is ADDITIONAL supplier exposure: Oil trade payable plus 6.48 Cr of GR/IR. A reader who assumes payables already covers it understates what JIVO owes.

OLDEST_UB_DAYS on the TOTAL row is over ALL cards, not external only (OLDEST_UB_DAYS). It happens to be an external receipt in all three books today, so the two agree - do not rely on that. It is NULL, never 0, when a facet has nothing unbilled (Oil: 44 of 60 VENDOR rows, 24 of 32 WAREHOUSE rows, 6 of 24 MONTH rows).

INV_SAMEDAY_PCT, INV_PAIR_DOCS, INV_SAMEDAY_DOCS and INV_LAG_* are NULL on every WAREHOUSE row by design - an invoice lag is a document property and a warehouse is a line attribute - and NULL wherever nothing was invoiced. Rendering NULL as 0% would report perfect failure where there is no measurement.

PO_DOCNUMS and AP_INVOICE_DOCNUMS change TYPE with cardinality: int when there is exactly one, comma-separated string when there are several, null when none. A renderer calling .split(',') crashes on the int; a renderer formatting it as a number mangles the list.

Ageing runs off the GRPO's own DocDate (OPDN.DocDate), which at JIVO is the gate-in date (C-0017) - not the A/P invoice date, which is a different date in the books (C-0022). Do not re-age this section on an invoice date to make it agree with a payables report.

Detail is capped at 1000 rows per company and summary at 300 (ORDER BY open value DESC). Live today 456/47/285 and 185/93/151, so nothing is truncated - but a renderer must check the cap rather than assume, or a growing GR/IR problem will quietly stop appearing.

The detail slice is a SEPARATE query, so summary and detail can disagree by up to a paisa per document from independent ROUNDing (verified live: Oil +0.07 across 456 documents, Mart +0.01, Bev +0.01). Any equality check needs a tolerance; a strict == will show a false red dot.

This section is genuinely live and moves during the working day. Between two reads seven minutes apart while writing this spec, Mart's UNBILLED_GROSS went from 1.66 Cr to 1.97 Cr as new intercompany receipts landed. Every figure here is stamped to one snapshot; never mix figures read at different times.

sql.text:
CASE WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(g."GroupName",''))            LIKE '%BRANCH%'      THEN 'BRANCH'
              WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(c."CardName",h."CardName"))   LIKE '%JIVO%'        THEN 'INTERCOMPANY'
              WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(c."CardName",h."CardName"))   LIKE 'STOCK GOODS%'  THEN 'INTERNAL_ADJ'
              ELSE 'EXTERNAL' END              AS PARTY_CLASS,
         IFNULL(TO_VARCHAR(h."BPLId"),'?')     AS BPL_ID,
         IFNULL(h."BPLName",'(no branch)')     AS BPL_NAME,
         DAYS_BETWEEN(h."DocDate", DATE'{{ASOF}}') AS AGE_DAYS
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.OPDN h
  LEFT JOIN {{SCHEMA}}.OCRD c ON c."CardCode"  = h."CardCode"
  LEFT JOIN {{SCHEMA}}.OCRG g ON g."GroupCode" = c."GroupCode"
                             AND g."GroupType" = c."CardType"
  WHERE h."CANCELED" = 'N' AND h."DocDate" <= DATE'{{ASOF}}'
),
L AS (   -- raw line fact: one row per GRPO line, header attributes denormalised on
  SELECT hd.DOC_ENTRY, hd.DOC_DATE, hd.DOC_STATUS, hd.CARD_CODE, hd.CARD_NAME,
         hd.PARTY_CLASS, hd.BPL_ID, hd.BPL_NAME, hd.AGE_DAYS,
         IFNULL(l."WhsCode",'(none)')                                  AS WHS,
         CAST(l."LineTotal" AS DOUBLE)                                 AS NET,
         CAST(l."GTotal" AS DOUBLE) - CAST(l."LineTotal" AS DOUBLE)    AS GST,
         CAST(l."GTotal" AS DOUBLE)                                    AS GROSS,
         CASE WHEN CAST(l."Quantity" AS DOUBLE) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS ZERO_QTY,
         CASE WHEN rt.DOC_ENTRY IS NOT NULL                       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS RETURNED,
         CASE WHEN rt.DOC_ENTRY IS NULL AND b.DOC_ENTRY IS NULL
               AND l."LineStatus" = 'O'                            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS UB,
         CASE WHEN rt.DOC_ENTRY IS NULL AND b.DOC_ENTRY IS NULL
               AND l."LineStatus" = 'C'                            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS CNB,
         iv.INV_COUNT, iv.FIRST_INV_DATE
  FROM HDR hd
  JOIN {{SCHEMA}}.PDN1 l ON l."DocEntry" = hd.DOC_ENTRY
  LEFT JOIN BILLED   b  ON b.DOC_ENTRY  = l."DocEntry" AND b.LINE_NUM  = l."LineNum"
  LEFT JOIN RETURNED rt ON rt.DOC_ENTRY = l."DocEntry" AND rt.LINE_NUM = l."LineNum"
  LEFT JOIN INVLINK  iv ON iv.DOC_ENTRY = hd.DOC_ENTRY
),
LF AS (  -- line fact with every per-row measure spelled out once
  SELECT DOC_ENTRY, DOC_DATE, DOC_STATUS, CARD_CODE, CARD_NAME, PARTY_CLASS,
         BPL_ID, BPL_NAME, AGE_DAYS, WHS, NET, GST, GROSS,
         1                          AS N_LINES,
         UB                         AS UB_LINES,
         UB * NET                   AS UB_NET,
         UB * GST                   AS UB_GST,
         UB * GROSS                 AS UB_GROSS,
         UB * ZERO_QTY              AS UB_ZQ_LINES,
         UB * ZERO_QTY * GROSS      AS UB_ZQ_GROSS,
         CNB                        AS CNB_LINES,
         CNB * GROSS                AS CNB_GROSS,
         RETURNED                   AS RET_LINES,
         RETURNED * GROSS           AS RET_GROSS,
         CASE WHEN UB  = 1 THEN DOC_DATE  END                       AS UB_DATE,
         CASE WHEN UB  = 1 THEN DOC_ENTRY END                       AS UB_DOC,
         CASE WHEN CNB = 1 THEN DOC_ENTRY END                       AS CNB_DOC,
         CASE WHEN RETURNED = 1 THEN DOC_ENTRY END                  AS RET_DOC,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS <=  30              THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_0_30,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS BETWEEN  31 AND  60 THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_31_60,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS BETWEEN  61 AND  90 THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_61_90,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS BETWEEN  91 AND 180 THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_91_180,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS BETWEEN 181 AND 365 THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_181_365,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS >  365              THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_365PLUS,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS >   90              THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_90P_GROSS,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS >   90 THEN DOC_ENTRY END                 AS UB_90P_DOC,
         CASE WHEN INV_COUNT > 0     THEN DOC_ENTRY END                          AS INV_DOC,
         CASE WHEN INV_COUNT IS NULL THEN DOC_ENTRY END                          AS NOINV_DOC,
         CASE WHEN INV_COUNT IS NULL THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END                       AS NOINV_GROSS,
         INV_COUNT, FIRST_INV_DATE
  FROM L
),
DF AS (  -- DOCUMENT-level fact: the SAME measure vocabulary, one row per GRPO.
         -- Only this level carries the C-0017 invoice-lag numbers, because a lag
         -- is a property of the document and not of any one line (trap 10).
  SELECT DOC_ENTRY,
         MIN(DOC_DATE) AS DOC_DATE, MIN(CARD_CODE) AS CARD_CODE, MIN(CARD_NAME) AS CARD_NAME,
         MIN(PARTY_CLASS) AS PARTY_CLASS, MIN(BPL_ID) AS BPL_ID, MIN(BPL_NAME) AS BPL_NAME,
         SUM(N_LINES) AS N_LINES, SUM(NET) AS NET, SUM(GST) AS GST, SUM(GROSS) AS GROSS,
         SUM(UB_LINES) AS UB_LINES, SUM(UB_NET) AS UB_NET, SUM(UB_GST) AS UB_GST,
         SUM(UB_GROSS) AS UB_GROSS, SUM(UB_ZQ_LINES) AS UB_ZQ_LINES, SUM(UB_ZQ_GROSS) AS UB_ZQ_GROSS,
         SUM(CNB_LINES) AS CNB_LINES, SUM(CNB_GROSS) AS CNB_GROSS,
         SUM(RET_LINES) AS RET_LINES, SUM(RET_GROSS) AS RET_GROSS,
         MIN(UB_DATE) AS UB_DATE, MIN(UB_DOC) AS UB_DOC, MIN(CNB_DOC) AS CNB_DOC, MIN(RET_DOC) AS RET_DOC,
         SUM(UB_0_30) AS UB_0_30, SUM(UB_31_60) AS UB_31_60, SUM(UB_61_90) AS UB_61_90,
         SUM(UB_91_180) AS UB_91_180, SUM(UB_181_365) AS UB_181_365, SUM(UB_365PLUS) AS UB_365PLUS,
         SUM(UB_90P_GROSS) AS UB_90P_GROSS, MIN(UB_90P_DOC) AS UB_90P_DOC,
         MIN(INV_DOC) AS INV_DOC, MIN(NOINV_DOC) AS NOINV_DOC, SUM(NOINV_GROSS) AS NOINV_GROSS,
         MIN(CASE WHEN INV_COUNT > 0 THEN DAYS_BETWEEN(DOC_DATE, FIRST_INV_DATE) END) AS INV_LAG,
         MIN(CASE WHEN INV_COUNT > 0 AND DAYS_BETWEEN(DOC_DATE, FIRST_INV_DATE) = 0
                  THEN DOC_ENTRY END) AS SAMEDAY_DOC
  FROM LF
  GROUP BY DOC_ENTRY
),
SCOPES AS (
  -- six DOCUMENT-level scopes, stacked; WAREHOUSE is added from the line fact below
              SELECT 'TOTAL'           AS S, '1' AS SK FROM DUMMY
  UNION ALL   SELECT 'CLASS',               '2'        FROM DUMMY
  UNION ALL   SELECT 'MONTH',               '3'        FROM DUMMY
  UNION ALL   SELECT 'BRANCH',              '4'        FROM DUMMY
  UNION ALL   SELECT 'VENDOR',              '5'        FROM DUMMY
  UNION ALL   SELECT 'VENDOR_UNBILLED',     '6'        FROM DUMMY
),
KEYED AS (
  SELECT s.S AS SCOPE,
         CASE s.S WHEN 'TOTAL'  THEN 'ALL'
                  WHEN 'CLASS'  THEN d.PARTY_CLASS
                  WHEN 'MONTH'  THEN TO_VARCHAR(d.DOC_DATE,'YYYY-MM')
                  WHEN 'BRANCH' THEN d.BPL_ID
                  ELSE d.CARD_CODE END                                  AS GRP_KEY,
         CASE s.S WHEN 'TOTAL'  THEN 'All GRPOs'
                  WHEN 'CLASS'  THEN d.PARTY_CLASS
                  WHEN 'MONTH'  THEN TO_VARCHAR(d.DOC_DATE,'YYYY-MM')
                  WHEN 'BRANCH' THEN UPPER(d.BPL_NAME)   -- OPDN."BPLName" is stored per DOCUMENT and its
                                                         -- capitalisation drifted ('FACTORY' vs 'Factory'),
                                                         -- which split branch 2 into two rows until upper-cased
                  ELSE d.CARD_NAME || ' [' || d.PARTY_CLASS || ']' END  AS GRP_LABEL,
         s.SK AS SORT_KEY,
         d.DOC_ENTRY, d.N_LINES, d.NET, d.GST, d.GROSS,
         d.UB_LINES, d.UB_NET, d.UB_GST, d.UB_GROSS, d.UB_ZQ_LINES, d.UB_ZQ_GROSS,
         d.CNB_LINES, d.CNB_GROSS, d.RET_LINES, d.RET_GROSS,
         d.UB_DATE, d.UB_DOC, d.CNB_DOC, d.RET_DOC,
         d.UB_0_30, d.UB_31_60, d.UB_61_90, d.UB_91_180, d.UB_181_365, d.UB_365PLUS,
         d.UB_90P_GROSS, d.UB_90P_DOC, d.INV_DOC, d.NOINV_DOC, d.NOINV_GROSS,
         d.INV_LAG, d.SAMEDAY_DOC, d.PARTY_CLASS AS PCLASS
  FROM DF d CROSS JOIN SCOPES s
),
KEYED_W AS (   -- WAREHOUSE: line-level, invoice-lag columns deliberately NULL (trap 10)
  SELECT 'WAREHOUSE' AS SCOPE, f.WHS AS GRP_KEY, f.WHS AS GRP_LABEL, '7' AS SORT_KEY,
         f.DOC_ENTRY, f.N_LINES, f.NET, f.GST, f.GROSS,
         f.UB_LINES, f.UB_NET, f.UB_GST, f.UB_GROSS, f.UB_ZQ_LINES, f.UB_ZQ_GROSS,
         f.CNB_LINES, f.CNB_GROSS, f.RET_LINES, f.RET_GROSS,
         f.UB_DATE, f.UB_DOC, f.CNB_DOC, f.RET_DOC,
         f.UB_0_30, f.UB_31_60, f.UB_61_90, f.UB_91_180, f.UB_181_365, f.UB_365PLUS,
         f.UB_90P_GROSS, f.UB_90P_DOC, f.INV_DOC, f.NOINV_DOC, f.NOINV_GROSS,
         CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS INV_LAG, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS SAMEDAY_DOC,
         f.PARTY_CLASS AS PCLASS
  FROM LF f
),
AGG AS (
  SELECT SCOPE, GRP_KEY, GRP_LABEL, SORT_KEY,
         COUNT(DISTINCT DOC_ENTRY)                  AS GRPO_DOCS,
         SUM(N_LINES)                               AS GRPO_LINES,
         ROUND(SUM(NET),2)                          AS GRPO_NET,
         ROUND(SUM(GST),2)                          AS GRPO_GST,
         ROUND(SUM(GROSS),2)                        AS GRPO_GROSS,
         COUNT(DISTINCT UB_DOC)                     AS UNBILLED_DOCS,
         SUM(UB_LINES)                              AS UNBILLED_LINES,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_NET),2)                       AS UNBILLED_NET,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_GST),2)                       AS UNBILLED_GST,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_GROSS),2)                     AS UNBILLED_GROSS,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_0_30),2)                      AS UB_0_30,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_31_60),2)                     AS UB_31_60,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_61_90),2)                     AS UB_61_90,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_91_180),2)                    AS UB_91_180,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_181_365),2)                   AS UB_181_365,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_365PLUS),2)                   AS UB_365PLUS,
         COUNT(DISTINCT UB_90P_DOC)                 AS UB_90PLUS_DOCS,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_90P_GROSS),2)                 AS UB_90PLUS_GROSS,
         SUM(UB_ZQ_LINES)                           AS UB_ZEROQTY_LINES,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_ZQ_GROSS),2)                  AS UB_ZEROQTY_GROSS,
         TO_VARCHAR(MIN(UB_DATE),'YYYY-MM-DD')      AS OLDEST_UB_DATE,
         DAYS_BETWEEN(MIN(UB_DATE), DATE'{{ASOF}}') AS OLDEST_UB_DAYS,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CNB_DOC)                    AS CLOSED_NOBILL_DOCS,
         SUM(CNB_LINES)                             AS CLOSED_NOBILL_LINES,
         ROUND(SUM(CNB_GROSS),2)                    AS CLOSED_NOBILL_GROSS,
         COUNT(DISTINCT RET_DOC)                    AS RETURNED_DOCS,
         SUM(RET_LINES)                             AS RETURNED_LINES,
         ROUND(SUM(RET_GROSS),2)                    AS RETURNED_GROSS,
         COUNT(DISTINCT INV_DOC)                    AS INVOICED_DOCS,
         COUNT(DISTINCT NOINV_DOC)                  AS NOINV_DOCS,
         ROUND(SUM(NOINV_GROSS),2)                  AS NOINV_GROSS,
         CASE WHEN SCOPE <> 'WAREHOUSE' THEN COUNT(INV_LAG) END           AS INV_PAIR_DOCS,
         CASE WHEN SCOPE <> 'WAREHOUSE' THEN COUNT(DISTINCT SAMEDAY_DOC) END AS INV_SAMEDAY_DOCS,
         CASE WHEN SCOPE <> 'WAREHOUSE' AND COUNT(INV_LAG) > 0
              THEN ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT SAMEDAY_DOC) / COUNT(INV_LAG), 2) END AS INV_SAMEDAY_PCT,
         ROUND(AVG(CAST(INV_LAG AS DOUBLE)),2)      AS INV_LAG_AVG_DAYS,
         ROUND(MEDIAN(CAST(INV_LAG AS DOUBLE)),2)   AS INV_LAG_MED_DAYS,
         -- EXTERNAL-ONLY TWINS (trap 12).  The five headline figures with JIVO's
         -- own branch / sister-company / stock-adjustment cards taken out, so a
         -- KPI can quote a real trade number instead of one that is 68% internal.
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PCLASS = 'EXTERNAL' THEN DOC_ENTRY END)          AS EXT_GRPO_DOCS,
         ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN PCLASS = 'EXTERNAL' THEN GROSS        ELSE 0 END),2)  AS EXT_GRPO_GROSS,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PCLASS = 'EXTERNAL' THEN UB_DOC END)             AS EXT_UNBILLED_DOCS,
         ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN PCLASS = 'EXTERNAL' THEN UB_GROSS     ELSE 0 END),2)  AS EXT_UNBILLED_GROSS,

terms.label: Unbilled receipt value, every card
terms.note: line is LineStatus='O', no live PCH1/OPCH draw, no live RPD1/ORPD draw

terms.label: On JIVO's own branch GST registrations
terms.note: stock moving between JIVO's own state registrations, never an outside bill

terms.label: On sister companies
terms.note: C-0020: Mart's VENDA000001 JIVO WELLNESS sits in group PURCHASE, only the NAME test catches it

terms.label: On the internal stock-adjustment card
terms.note: Bev VENDA001306 STOCK GOODS RECEIPTS will never issue a vendor bill

terms.label: Unbilled owed to outside suppliers
terms.note: the GR/IR liability Accounts must chase

caveats.right: There are 23 related-party customer cards across the three companies (Oil 9, Mart 8, Beverages 6). All of them are group entities, so all of them are intercompany. Exclude the whole set, not one card, and name which cards were excluded.
caveats.rule: Intercompany is 23 group CardCodes, not just CUSTA000606: Oil CUSTA000001/2/3/4/606/827/906/1099/1113, Mart CUSTA000001/827/874/875/876/877/878/926, Bev CUSTA000001/2/3/4/606/827. Exclude all; name them.
caveats.title: Intercompany is 23 group cards, not just CUSTA000606
caveats.wrong: Split external vs intercompany by excluding only CUSTA000606 (JIVO MART PVT LTD), per C-0002. That leaves every other group card counted as an outside customer — JIVO WELLNESS DL/HR/PB/HP, JIVO MART HR/DL/PB/KR/RJ/UP/ISD, JIVO BEVERAGES-CUST. June-2026 olive: Mart 'external' came out Rs 10.47 Cr excluding only CUSTA000606, against Rs 9.53 Cr excluding all eight of Mart's group cards — a Rs 1.53 Cr overstatement of outside business.

caveats.right: On the vendor side several intercompany accounts sit in ordinary trading groups, so a group-only test silently counts JIVO's own money as external trade payable. Measured live 2026-08-21: Mart VENDA000001 'JIVO WELLNESS PVT LTD' is in group PURCHASE at -20.93 Cr and is Mart's single largest payable; Mart VENDA000004 'JIVO WELLNESS PVT LTD - DL' also in PURCHASE; Oil VENDA000483 'JIVO MART PVT LTD' is in group E-COMMERCE at -2.25 Cr. Together 23.19 Cr is missed. The remaining group entities do sit in BRANCH VENDOR, so the group test is necessary but not sufficient. Correction C-0005 lists 23 intercompany CardCodes but they are all CUSTA* — it covers no vendor codes at all. Test the group AND the CardName (JIVO / AKAL), and flag the rows rather than dropping them.
caveats.rule: Intercompany vendors hide outside BRANCH groups: Mart VENDA000001 'JIVO WELLNESS' is in group PURCHASE (-20.93 Cr), Oil VENDA000483 in E-COMMERCE. Match OCRD.CardName too, never group alone.
caveats.title: Intercompany vendors hide outside the BRANCH groups — match on name too
caveats.wrong: Identified JIVO's own intercompany and branch accounts by joining OCRD to OCRG and testing GroupName LIKE '%BRANCH%', assuming that catches every group entity.

check.method: reproduces the figure measured independently from the SQL when the section was catalogued

grpo-unbilled-internal.closure_note: Terms describe how the query built this figure; they are not addends over a row set, so no arithmetic closure is asserted.
grpo-unbilled-internal.formula: UNBILLED_GROSS - EXT_UNBILLED_GROSS = unbilled sitting on branch / sister-company / stock-adjustment cards
grpo-unbilled-internal.label: Of the unbilled, the part on JIVO's own cards
grpo-unbilled-internal.method: sum of the signed terms - this figure spans several columns, so the single column UNBILLED_GROSS is only its first term
section_traps: FACETED - the single biggest error available here. Seven scopes are stacked in one result (TOTAL, CLASS, MONTH, BRANCH, VENDOR, VENDOR_UNBILLED, WAREHOUSE). Summing every row multiplies the book by roughly seven. The TOTAL row is SCOPE=='TOTAL' AND GRP_KEY=='ALL' - exactly one row per company (verified: 1/1/1).

VENDOR and VENDOR_UNBILLED are TOP-60 and do NOT re-total (SCOPE, GRP_KEY). Verified live: Oil VENDOR sums to 36.43 Cr LESS than TOTAL GRPO_GROSS and VENDOR_UNBILLED to 647.92 Cr less (it is ordered by unbilled value, not receipt value). Re-totalling from a vendor facet silently understates. CLASS, MONTH and BRANCH do re-total to the paisa.

WAREHOUSE money re-totals but WAREHOUSE DOC COUNTS DO NOT (GRPO_DOCS, UNBILLED_DOCS). A receipt spanning two warehouses is counted once in each row - verified live: Oil sums to 10,668 against a TOTAL of 10,663, Mart +2, Bev +7. Never add up GRPO_DOCS across WAREHOUSE.

UNBILLED_GROSS is contaminated by JIVO's own cards. Live today: 64.5% of Beverages' 4.41 Cr is the internal card VENDA001306 'STOCK GOODS RECEIPTS' (which will never receive a vendor bill) and 92% of Mart's 1.97 Cr is VENDA000001 'JIVO WELLNESS PVT LTD'. Quote EXT_UNBILLED_GROSS as the liability and name what came out (C-0005, C-0020).

OPDN.CANCELED is THREE-valued (CANCELED): 'N' live, 'Y' the cancelled original, 'C' SAP's cancellation mirror, and 'Y' and 'C' carry IDENTICAL totals. A '<> Y' filter adds 94.63 Cr of phantom receipts to Oil. The SQL keeps only 'N', on OPDN and on every linked OPCH and ORPD (C-0021).

HAS_AP_INVOICE is NOT the unbilled test (HAS_AP_INVOICE). It is text 'Y'/'N', not 0/1, and a partly-billed receipt reads 'Y' while still carrying unbilled lines. PLAN-V2 section 3.4 proposes 'sum of grpo detail rows where HAS_AP_INVOICE = 0' as the independent check for this KPI: that recipe is WRONG and overstates by 59.73 L (Oil), 41.52 L (Mart) and 35.03 L (Bev) because it sweeps in the CLOSED_NOBILL rows. The correct filter is ROW_KIND=='UNBILLED'.

CLOSED_NOBILL_GROSS is not a liability (CLOSED_NOBILL_GROSS). Somebody closed the receipt and the bill never came - an audit item. Adding it to UNBILLED_GROSS to get 'total exposure' is wrong twice over: it is not owed, and NOINV_GROSS already counts those documents at their FULL value rather than at the offending lines.

NOINV_GROSS is not UNBILLED_GROSS (NOINV_GROSS, UNBILLED_GROSS). NOINV_* counts whole documents with no invoice anywhere at their full receipt value; UNBILLED_* counts only the offending LINES. Live Oil: 7.12 Cr against 6.48 Cr. They are different questions and the names do not say so.

PDN1.OpenQty is broken at JIVO (OpenQty) - it still equals Quantity on fully invoiced closed lines - and OpenInvQty is stated in the BASE UoM while Quantity is in the DOCUMENT UoM (oil RM factor 1098.9). Neither is used, and no quantity arithmetic exists anywhere in this section. Do not add one (C-0001).

Zero-quantity freight and expense lines never close by themselves (UB_ZEROQTY_LINES). A naive LineStatus='O' count overstates Oil's GR/IR by 18 documents. They are excluded by the live-invoice link, and the genuinely unbilled ones are reported separately - Oil 178 lines / 16.74 L, Mart 63 / 14.67 L, Bev 206 / 12.35 L. That value is INSIDE UNBILLED_GROSS; do not add it on top.

DOC_STATUS is display only (DOC_STATUS, OPDN.DocStatus). It disagrees with the lines in both directions - live today 2 Oil, 1 Mart and 3 Bev detail rows read 'C' yet are ROW_KIND='UNBILLED'. Open-ness is decided line by line, exactly as C-0019 requires for the A/R side.

OPEN_GROSS can exceed DOC_GROSS and that is correct (OPEN_GROSS, DOC_GROSS). On 166 of 456 Oil detail rows, 28 of 47 Mart and 213 of 285 Bev the header carries VatSum=0 while the lines carry tax, so DOC_GROSS is the NET receipt. DOC_* reconciles to the SAP screen; OPEN_* is the number to chase. Never 'fix' one to match the other.

Money is line-level throughout (PDN1.GTotal), never OPDN.DocTotal, so header freight (OPDN.TotalExpns, Oil ~9.50 L) is NOT in any figure on this page. Anyone reconciling this section to a header-total report will be out by the freight and by the hidden line tax in both directions.

RETURNED_DOCS / RETURNED_LINES / RETURNED_GROSS do not mean 'goods sent back' (RETURNED_GROSS). 96%+ of JIVO's goods returns are raised standalone with RPD1.BaseType=-1 and no GRPO link, so these columns are near-empty by construction (Oil 3 docs, Mart 1, Bev 0). Consequence: goods received, never billed and then returned standalone STAY in the GR/IR bucket. Upper bound by vendor overlap: Oil 43.50 L, Bev 0.83 L.

This is a TODAY dashboard (PDN1.LineStatus). LineStatus is a current-state flag with no history, so a historical --as-of run silently DROPS lines that were open then and have since been billed - measured at as-of 2026-05-31: Oil 143 docs / 67.69 L and Bev 165 / 8.81 L invisible. Never quote a month-end GR/IR provision from this section without saying so.

INTERNAL_ADJ and INTERCOMPANY are detected by CARD NAME (CardName LIKE 'STOCK GOODS%' and LIKE '%JIVO%'). A differently-named internal adjustment card would be classed EXTERNAL and would inflate EXT_UNBILLED_GROSS - the very number the headline quotes. Unresolved; worth a jivo-correct if Accounts knows the real rule.

GR/IR is NOT in the A/P ledger. By definition no vendor bill exists, so none of this appears in vendor-ageing / payables and it must never be reconciled against them. It is ADDITIONAL supplier exposure: Oil trade payable plus 6.48 Cr of GR/IR. A reader who assumes payables already covers it understates what JIVO owes.

OLDEST_UB_DAYS on the TOTAL row is over ALL cards, not external only (OLDEST_UB_DAYS). It happens to be an external receipt in all three books today, so the two agree - do not rely on that. It is NULL, never 0, when a facet has nothing unbilled (Oil: 44 of 60 VENDOR rows, 24 of 32 WAREHOUSE rows, 6 of 24 MONTH rows).

INV_SAMEDAY_PCT, INV_PAIR_DOCS, INV_SAMEDAY_DOCS and INV_LAG_* are NULL on every WAREHOUSE row by design - an invoice lag is a document property and a warehouse is a line attribute - and NULL wherever nothing was invoiced. Rendering NULL as 0% would report perfect failure where there is no measurement.

PO_DOCNUMS and AP_INVOICE_DOCNUMS change TYPE with cardinality: int when there is exactly one, comma-separated string when there are several, null when none. A renderer calling .split(',') crashes on the int; a renderer formatting it as a number mangles the list.

Ageing runs off the GRPO's own DocDate (OPDN.DocDate), which at JIVO is the gate-in date (C-0017) - not the A/P invoice date, which is a different date in the books (C-0022). Do not re-age this section on an invoice date to make it agree with a payables report.

Detail is capped at 1000 rows per company and summary at 300 (ORDER BY open value DESC). Live today 456/47/285 and 185/93/151, so nothing is truncated - but a renderer must check the cap rather than assume, or a growing GR/IR problem will quietly stop appearing.

The detail slice is a SEPARATE query, so summary and detail can disagree by up to a paisa per document from independent ROUNDing (verified live: Oil +0.07 across 456 documents, Mart +0.01, Bev +0.01). Any equality check needs a tolerance; a strict == will show a false red dot.

This section is genuinely live and moves during the working day. Between two reads seven minutes apart while writing this spec, Mart's UNBILLED_GROSS went from 1.66 Cr to 1.97 Cr as new intercompany receipts landed. Every figure here is stamped to one snapshot; never mix figures read at different times.

sql.text:
CASE WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(g."GroupName",''))            LIKE '%BRANCH%'      THEN 'BRANCH'
              WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(c."CardName",h."CardName"))   LIKE '%JIVO%'        THEN 'INTERCOMPANY'
              WHEN UPPER(IFNULL(c."CardName",h."CardName"))   LIKE 'STOCK GOODS%'  THEN 'INTERNAL_ADJ'
              ELSE 'EXTERNAL' END              AS PARTY_CLASS,
         IFNULL(TO_VARCHAR(h."BPLId"),'?')     AS BPL_ID,
         IFNULL(h."BPLName",'(no branch)')     AS BPL_NAME,
         DAYS_BETWEEN(h."DocDate", DATE'{{ASOF}}') AS AGE_DAYS
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.OPDN h
  LEFT JOIN {{SCHEMA}}.OCRD c ON c."CardCode"  = h."CardCode"
  LEFT JOIN {{SCHEMA}}.OCRG g ON g."GroupCode" = c."GroupCode"
                             AND g."GroupType" = c."CardType"
  WHERE h."CANCELED" = 'N' AND h."DocDate" <= DATE'{{ASOF}}'
),
L AS (   -- raw line fact: one row per GRPO line, header attributes denormalised on
  SELECT hd.DOC_ENTRY, hd.DOC_DATE, hd.DOC_STATUS, hd.CARD_CODE, hd.CARD_NAME,
         hd.PARTY_CLASS, hd.BPL_ID, hd.BPL_NAME, hd.AGE_DAYS,
         IFNULL(l."WhsCode",'(none)')                                  AS WHS,
         CAST(l."LineTotal" AS DOUBLE)                                 AS NET,
         CAST(l."GTotal" AS DOUBLE) - CAST(l."LineTotal" AS DOUBLE)    AS GST,
         CAST(l."GTotal" AS DOUBLE)                                    AS GROSS,
         CASE WHEN CAST(l."Quantity" AS DOUBLE) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END  AS ZERO_QTY,
         CASE WHEN rt.DOC_ENTRY IS NOT NULL                       THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS RETURNED,
         CASE WHEN rt.DOC_ENTRY IS NULL AND b.DOC_ENTRY IS NULL
               AND l."LineStatus" = 'O'                            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS UB,
         CASE WHEN rt.DOC_ENTRY IS NULL AND b.DOC_ENTRY IS NULL
               AND l."LineStatus" = 'C'                            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS CNB,
         iv.INV_COUNT, iv.FIRST_INV_DATE
  FROM HDR hd
  JOIN {{SCHEMA}}.PDN1 l ON l."DocEntry" = hd.DOC_ENTRY
  LEFT JOIN BILLED   b  ON b.DOC_ENTRY  = l."DocEntry" AND b.LINE_NUM  = l."LineNum"
  LEFT JOIN RETURNED rt ON rt.DOC_ENTRY = l."DocEntry" AND rt.LINE_NUM = l."LineNum"
  LEFT JOIN INVLINK  iv ON iv.DOC_ENTRY = hd.DOC_ENTRY
),
LF AS (  -- line fact with every per-row measure spelled out once
  SELECT DOC_ENTRY, DOC_DATE, DOC_STATUS, CARD_CODE, CARD_NAME, PARTY_CLASS,
         BPL_ID, BPL_NAME, AGE_DAYS, WHS, NET, GST, GROSS,
         1                          AS N_LINES,
         UB                         AS UB_LINES,
         UB * NET                   AS UB_NET,
         UB * GST                   AS UB_GST,
         UB * GROSS                 AS UB_GROSS,
         UB * ZERO_QTY              AS UB_ZQ_LINES,
         UB * ZERO_QTY * GROSS      AS UB_ZQ_GROSS,
         CNB                        AS CNB_LINES,
         CNB * GROSS                AS CNB_GROSS,
         RETURNED                   AS RET_LINES,
         RETURNED * GROSS           AS RET_GROSS,
         CASE WHEN UB  = 1 THEN DOC_DATE  END                       AS UB_DATE,
         CASE WHEN UB  = 1 THEN DOC_ENTRY END                       AS UB_DOC,
         CASE WHEN CNB = 1 THEN DOC_ENTRY END                       AS CNB_DOC,
         CASE WHEN RETURNED = 1 THEN DOC_ENTRY END                  AS RET_DOC,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS <=  30              THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_0_30,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS BETWEEN  31 AND  60 THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_31_60,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS BETWEEN  61 AND  90 THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_61_90,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS BETWEEN  91 AND 180 THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_91_180,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS BETWEEN 181 AND 365 THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_181_365,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS >  365              THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_365PLUS,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS >   90              THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_90P_GROSS,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS >   90 THEN DOC_ENTRY END                 AS UB_90P_DOC,
         CASE WHEN INV_COUNT > 0     THEN DOC_ENTRY END                          AS INV_DOC,
         CASE WHEN INV_COUNT IS NULL THEN DOC_ENTRY END                          AS NOINV_DOC,
         CASE WHEN INV_COUNT IS NULL THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END                       AS NOINV_GROSS,
         INV_COUNT, FIRST_INV_DATE
  FROM L
),
DF AS (  -- DOCUMENT-level fact: the SAME measure vocabulary, one row per GRPO.
         -- Only this level carries the C-0017 invoice-lag numbers, because a lag
         -- is a property of the document and not of any one line (trap 10).
  SELECT DOC_ENTRY,
         MIN(DOC_DATE) AS DOC_DATE, MIN(CARD_CODE) AS CARD_CODE, MIN(CARD_NAME) AS CARD_NAME,
         MIN(PARTY_CLASS) AS PARTY_CLASS, MIN(BPL_ID) AS BPL_ID, MIN(BPL_NAME) AS BPL_NAME,
         SUM(N_LINES) AS N_LINES, SUM(NET) AS NET, SUM(GST) AS GST, SUM(GROSS) AS GROSS,
         SUM(UB_LINES) AS UB_LINES, SUM(UB_NET) AS UB_NET, SUM(UB_GST) AS UB_GST,
         SUM(UB_GROSS) AS UB_GROSS, SUM(UB_ZQ_LINES) AS UB_ZQ_LINES, SUM(UB_ZQ_GROSS) AS UB_ZQ_GROSS,
         SUM(CNB_LINES) AS CNB_LINES, SUM(CNB_GROSS) AS CNB_GROSS,
         SUM(RET_LINES) AS RET_LINES, SUM(RET_GROSS) AS RET_GROSS,
         MIN(UB_DATE) AS UB_DATE, MIN(UB_DOC) AS UB_DOC, MIN(CNB_DOC) AS CNB_DOC, MIN(RET_DOC) AS RET_DOC,
         SUM(UB_0_30) AS UB_0_30, SUM(UB_31_60) AS UB_31_60, SUM(UB_61_90) AS UB_61_90,
         SUM(UB_91_180) AS UB_91_180, SUM(UB_181_365) AS UB_181_365, SUM(UB_365PLUS) AS UB_365PLUS,
         SUM(UB_90P_GROSS) AS UB_90P_GROSS, MIN(UB_90P_DOC) AS UB_90P_DOC,
         MIN(INV_DOC) AS INV_DOC, MIN(NOINV_DOC) AS NOINV_DOC, SUM(NOINV_GROSS) AS NOINV_GROSS,
         MIN(CASE WHEN INV_COUNT > 0 THEN DAYS_BETWEEN(DOC_DATE, FIRST_INV_DATE) END) AS INV_LAG,
         MIN(CASE WHEN INV_COUNT > 0 AND DAYS_BETWEEN(DOC_DATE, FIRST_INV_DATE) = 0
                  THEN DOC_ENTRY END) AS SAMEDAY_DOC
  FROM LF
  GROUP BY DOC_ENTRY
),
SCOPES AS (
  -- six DOCUMENT-level scopes, stacked; WAREHOUSE is added from the line fact below
              SELECT 'TOTAL'           AS S, '1' AS SK FROM DUMMY
  UNION ALL   SELECT 'CLASS',               '2'        FROM DUMMY
  UNION ALL   SELECT 'MONTH',               '3'        FROM DUMMY
  UNION ALL   SELECT 'BRANCH',              '4'        FROM DUMMY
  UNION ALL   SELECT 'VENDOR',              '5'        FROM DUMMY
  UNION ALL   SELECT 'VENDOR_UNBILLED',     '6'        FROM DUMMY
),
KEYED AS (
  SELECT s.S AS SCOPE,
         CASE s.S WHEN 'TOTAL'  THEN 'ALL'
                  WHEN 'CLASS'  THEN d.PARTY_CLASS
                  WHEN 'MONTH'  THEN TO_VARCHAR(d.DOC_DATE,'YYYY-MM')
                  WHEN 'BRANCH' THEN d.BPL_ID
                  ELSE d.CARD_CODE END                                  AS GRP_KEY,
         CASE s.S WHEN 'TOTAL'  THEN 'All GRPOs'
                  WHEN 'CLASS'  THEN d.PARTY_CLASS
                  WHEN 'MONTH'  THEN TO_VARCHAR(d.DOC_DATE,'YYYY-MM')
                  WHEN 'BRANCH' THEN UPPER(d.BPL_NAME)   -- OPDN."BPLName" is stored per DOCUMENT and its
                                                         -- capitalisation drifted ('FACTORY' vs 'Factory'),
                                                         -- which split branch 2 into two rows until upper-cased
                  ELSE d.CARD_NAME || ' [' || d.PARTY_CLASS || ']' END  AS GRP_LABEL,
         s.SK AS SORT_KEY,
         d.DOC_ENTRY, d.N_LINES, d.NET, d.GST, d.GROSS,
         d.UB_LINES, d.UB_NET, d.UB_GST, d.UB_GROSS, d.UB_ZQ_LINES, d.UB_ZQ_GROSS,
         d.CNB_LINES, d.CNB_GROSS, d.RET_LINES, d.RET_GROSS,
         d.UB_DATE, d.UB_DOC, d.CNB_DOC, d.RET_DOC,
         d.UB_0_30, d.UB_31_60, d.UB_61_90, d.UB_91_180, d.UB_181_365, d.UB_365PLUS,
         d.UB_90P_GROSS, d.UB_90P_DOC, d.INV_DOC, d.NOINV_DOC, d.NOINV_GROSS,
         d.INV_LAG, d.SAMEDAY_DOC, d.PARTY_CLASS AS PCLASS
  FROM DF d CROSS JOIN SCOPES s
),
KEYED_W AS (   -- WAREHOUSE: line-level, invoice-lag columns deliberately NULL (trap 10)
  SELECT 'WAREHOUSE' AS SCOPE, f.WHS AS GRP_KEY, f.WHS AS GRP_LABEL, '7' AS SORT_KEY,
         f.DOC_ENTRY, f.N_LINES, f.NET, f.GST, f.GROSS,
         f.UB_LINES, f.UB_NET, f.UB_GST, f.UB_GROSS, f.UB_ZQ_LINES, f.UB_ZQ_GROSS,
         f.CNB_LINES, f.CNB_GROSS, f.RET_LINES, f.RET_GROSS,
         f.UB_DATE, f.UB_DOC, f.CNB_DOC, f.RET_DOC,
         f.UB_0_30, f.UB_31_60, f.UB_61_90, f.UB_91_180, f.UB_181_365, f.UB_365PLUS,
         f.UB_90P_GROSS, f.UB_90P_DOC, f.INV_DOC, f.NOINV_DOC, f.NOINV_GROSS,
         CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS INV_LAG, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS SAMEDAY_DOC,
         f.PARTY_CLASS AS PCLASS
  FROM LF f
),
AGG AS (
  SELECT SCOPE, GRP_KEY, GRP_LABEL, SORT_KEY,
         COUNT(DISTINCT DOC_ENTRY)                  AS GRPO_DOCS,
         SUM(N_LINES)                               AS GRPO_LINES,
         ROUND(SUM(NET),2)                          AS GRPO_NET,
         ROUND(SUM(GST),2)                          AS GRPO_GST,
         ROUND(SUM(GROSS),2)                        AS GRPO_GROSS,
         COUNT(DISTINCT UB_DOC)                     AS UNBILLED_DOCS,
         SUM(UB_LINES)                              AS UNBILLED_LINES,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_NET),2)                       AS UNBILLED_NET,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_GST),2)                       AS UNBILLED_GST,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_GROSS),2)                     AS UNBILLED_GROSS,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_0_30),2)                      AS UB_0_30,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_31_60),2)                     AS UB_31_60,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_61_90),2)                     AS UB_61_90,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_91_180),2)                    AS UB_91_180,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_181_365),2)                   AS UB_181_365,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_365PLUS),2)                   AS UB_365PLUS,
         COUNT(DISTINCT UB_90P_DOC)                 AS UB_90PLUS_DOCS,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_90P_GROSS),2)                 AS UB_90PLUS_GROSS,
         SUM(UB_ZQ_LINES)                           AS UB_ZEROQTY_LINES,
         ROUND(SUM(UB_ZQ_GROSS),2)                  AS UB_ZEROQTY_GROSS,
         TO_VARCHAR(MIN(UB_DATE),'YYYY-MM-DD')      AS OLDEST_UB_DATE,
         DAYS_BETWEEN(MIN(UB_DATE), DATE'{{ASOF}}') AS OLDEST_UB_DAYS,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CNB_DOC)                    AS CLOSED_NOBILL_DOCS,
         SUM(CNB_LINES)                             AS CLOSED_NOBILL_LINES,
         ROUND(SUM(CNB_GROSS),2)                    AS CLOSED_NOBILL_GROSS,
         COUNT(DISTINCT RET_DOC)                    AS RETURNED_DOCS,
         SUM(RET_LINES)                             AS RETURNED_LINES,
         ROUND(SUM(RET_GROSS),2)                    AS RETURNED_GROSS,
         COUNT(DISTINCT INV_DOC)                    AS INVOICED_DOCS,
         COUNT(DISTINCT NOINV_DOC)                  AS NOINV_DOCS,
         ROUND(SUM(NOINV_GROSS),2)                  AS NOINV_GROSS,
         CASE WHEN SCOPE <> 'WAREHOUSE' THEN COUNT(INV_LAG) END           AS INV_PAIR_DOCS,
         CASE WHEN SCOPE <> 'WAREHOUSE' THEN COUNT(DISTINCT SAMEDAY_DOC) END AS INV_SAMEDAY_DOCS,
         CASE WHEN SCOPE <> 'WAREHOUSE' AND COUNT(INV_LAG) > 0
              THEN ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT SAMEDAY_DOC) / COUNT(INV_LAG), 2) END AS INV_SAMEDAY_PCT,
         ROUND(AVG(CAST(INV_LAG AS DOUBLE)),2)      AS INV_LAG_AVG_DAYS,
         ROUND(MEDIAN(CAST(INV_LAG AS DOUBLE)),2)   AS INV_LAG_MED_DAYS,
         -- EXTERNAL-ONLY TWINS (trap 12).  The five headline figures with JIVO's
         -- own branch / sister-company / stock-adjustment cards taken out, so a
         -- KPI can quote a real trade number instead of one that is 68% internal.
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PCLASS = 'EXTERNAL' THEN DOC_ENTRY END)          AS EXT_GRPO_DOCS,
         ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN PCLASS = 'EXTERNAL' THEN GROSS        ELSE 0 END),2)  AS EXT_GRPO_GROSS,
         COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PCLASS = 'EXTERNAL' THEN UB_DOC END)             AS EXT_UNBILLED_DOCS,
         ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN PCLASS = 'EXTERNAL' THEN UB_GROSS     ELSE 0 END),2)  AS EXT_UNBILLED_GROSS,

terms.label: JIVO's own
terms.note: never a real supplier liability; it is stock moved inside the group

caveats.right: There are 23 related-party customer cards across the three companies (Oil 9, Mart 8, Beverages 6). All of them are group entities, so all of them are intercompany. Exclude the whole set, not one card, and name which cards were excluded.
caveats.rule: Intercompany is 23 group CardCodes, not just CUSTA000606: Oil CUSTA000001/2/3/4/606/827/906/1099/1113, Mart CUSTA000001/827/874/875/876/877/878/926, Bev CUSTA000001/2/3/4/606/827. Exclude all; name them.
caveats.title: Intercompany is 23 group cards, not just CUSTA000606
caveats.wrong: Split external vs intercompany by excluding only CUSTA000606 (JIVO MART PVT LTD), per C-0002. That leaves every other group card counted as an outside customer — JIVO WELLNESS DL/HR/PB/HP, JIVO MART HR/DL/PB/KR/RJ/UP/ISD, JIVO BEVERAGES-CUST. June-2026 olive: Mart 'external' came out Rs 10.47 Cr excluding only CUSTA000606, against Rs 9.53 Cr excluding all eight of Mart's group cards — a Rs 1.53 Cr overstatement of outside business.

caveats.right: JIVO posts an A/P invoice on the gate-in date: DocDate = the date on the JIVO gate stamp, which is also the GRPO's DocDate. TaxDate (document date) carries the vendor's invoice date. Due date then follows the vendor's payment terms from there.
caveats.rule: A/P invoice DocDate (posting) = gate-in date = the GRPO's DocDate; TaxDate = vendor's invoice date. Never post on today's date or on the vendor's date.
caveats.title: A/P invoice posting date = gate-in date, doc date = vendor invoice date
caveats.wrong: Assumed an A/P invoice could be posted on today's date or on the vendor's invoice date.

check.method: reproduces the figure measured independently from the SQL when the section was catalogued

grpo-unbilled-rate-pct.closure_note: Terms describe how the query built this figure; they are not addends over a row set, so no arithmetic closure is asserted.

excludes.label: JIVO's own cards on both sides
excludes.note: This exclusion is described in the section spec but not expressed as a filter over the published rows, so its amount cannot be computed here: "PARTY_CLASS != 'EXTERNAL'"

grpo-unbilled-rate-pct.label: Share of outside receipts still unbilled
section_traps: FACETED - the single biggest error available here. Seven scopes are stacked in one result (TOTAL, CLASS, MONTH, BRANCH, VENDOR, VENDOR_UNBILLED, WAREHOUSE). Summing every row multiplies the book by roughly seven. The TOTAL row is SCOPE=='TOTAL' AND GRP_KEY=='ALL' - exactly one row per company (verified: 1/1/1).

VENDOR and VENDOR_UNBILLED are TOP-60 and do NOT re-total (SCOPE, GRP_KEY). Verified live: Oil VENDOR sums to 36.43 Cr LESS than TOTAL GRPO_GROSS and VENDOR_UNBILLED to 647.92 Cr less (it is ordered by unbilled value, not receipt value). Re-totalling from a vendor facet silently understates. CLASS, MONTH and BRANCH do re-total to the paisa.

WAREHOUSE money re-totals but WAREHOUSE DOC COUNTS DO NOT (GRPO_DOCS, UNBILLED_DOCS). A receipt spanning two warehouses is counted once in each row - verified live: Oil sums to 10,668 against a TOTAL of 10,663, Mart +2, Bev +7. Never add up GRPO_DOCS across WAREHOUSE.

UNBILLED_GROSS is contaminated by JIVO's own cards. Live today: 64.5% of Beverages' 4.41 Cr is the internal card VENDA001306 'STOCK GOODS RECEIPTS' (which will never receive a vendor bill) and 92% of Mart's 1.97 Cr is VENDA000001 'JIVO WELLNESS PVT LTD'. Quote EXT_UNBILLED_GROSS as the liability and name what came out (C-0005, C-0020).

OPDN.CANCELED is THREE-valued (CANCELED): 'N' live, 'Y' the cancelled original, 'C' SAP's cancellation mirror, and 'Y' and 'C' carry IDENTICAL totals. A '<> Y' filter adds 94.63 Cr of phantom receipts to Oil. The SQL keeps only 'N', on OPDN and on every linked OPCH and ORPD (C-0021).

HAS_AP_INVOICE is NOT the unbilled test (HAS_AP_INVOICE). It is text 'Y'/'N', not 0/1, and a partly-billed receipt reads 'Y' while still carrying unbilled lines. PLAN-V2 section 3.4 proposes 'sum of grpo detail rows where HAS_AP_INVOICE = 0' as the independent check for this KPI: that recipe is WRONG and overstates by 59.73 L (Oil), 41.52 L (Mart) and 35.03 L (Bev) because it sweeps in the CLOSED_NOBILL rows. The correct filter is ROW_KIND=='UNBILLED'.

CLOSED_NOBILL_GROSS is not a liability (CLOSED_NOBILL_GROSS). Somebody closed the receipt and the bill never came - an audit item. Adding it to UNBILLED_GROSS to get 'total exposure' is wrong twice over: it is not owed, and NOINV_GROSS already counts those documents at their FULL value rather than at the offending lines.

NOINV_GROSS is not UNBILLED_GROSS (NOINV_GROSS, UNBILLED_GROSS). NOINV_* counts whole documents with no invoice anywhere at their full receipt value; UNBILLED_* counts only the offending LINES. Live Oil: 7.12 Cr against 6.48 Cr. They are different questions and the names do not say so.

PDN1.OpenQty is broken at JIVO (OpenQty) - it still equals Quantity on fully invoiced closed lines - and OpenInvQty is stated in the BASE UoM while Quantity is in the DOCUMENT UoM (oil RM factor 1098.9). Neither is used, and no quantity arithmetic exists anywhere in this section. Do not add one (C-0001).

Zero-quantity freight and expense lines never close by themselves (UB_ZEROQTY_LINES). A naive LineStatus='O' count overstates Oil's GR/IR by 18 documents. They are excluded by the live-invoice link, and the genuinely unbilled ones are reported separately - Oil 178 lines / 16.74 L, Mart 63 / 14.67 L, Bev 206 / 12.35 L. That value is INSIDE UNBILLED_GROSS; do not add it on top.

DOC_STATUS is display only (DOC_STATUS, OPDN.DocStatus). It disagrees with the lines in both directions - live today 2 Oil, 1 Mart and 3 Bev detail rows read 'C' yet are ROW_KIND='UNBILLED'. Open-ness is decided line by line, exactly as C-0019 requires for the A/R side.

OPEN_GROSS can exceed DOC_GROSS and that is correct (OPEN_GROSS, DOC_GROSS). On 166 of 456 Oil detail rows, 28 of 47 Mart and 213 of 285 Bev the header carries VatSum=0 while the lines carry tax, so DOC_GROSS is the NET receipt. caveats.right: JIVO posts an A/P invoice on the gate-in date: DocDate = the date on the JIVO gate stamp, which is also the GRPO's DocDate. TaxDate (document date) carries the vendor's invoice date. Due date then follows the vendor's payment terms from there.
caveats.rule: A/P invoice DocDate (posting) = gate-in date = the GRPO's DocDate; TaxDate = vendor's invoice date. Never post on today's date or on the vendor's date.
caveats.title: A/P invoice posting date = gate-in date, doc date = vendor invoice date
caveats.wrong: Assumed an A/P invoice could be posted on today's date or on the vendor's invoice date.

caveats.right: At JIVO a document stays DocStatus='O' long after the money moved, because settlements are posted as manual journal entries (JDT1.TransType=30) and as on-account ORCT/OVPM receipts and payments that are never internally reconciled to the document. OCRD.Balance is the only ground truth for what a party owes or is owed. Measured live 2026-08-21, open documents vs OCRD balances: Oil A/R 180.69 vs 109.51 Cr and A/P 309.20 vs 102.63 Cr; Mart A/R 128.12 vs 23.35 Cr and A/P 219.60 vs 29.22 Cr; Bev A/R 6.34 vs 4.83 Cr and A/P 3.56 vs 2.24 Cr. Overstatement 1.3x to 7.5x, worst on Mart payables. Correct method: take the party balance as the real exposure, derive unapplied credit as sum(open docs) - balance, consume it oldest-due-first, then bucket the remainder.
caveats.rule: SAP DocStatus='O' is unreliable at JIVO: documents settled by manual JE or unapplied on-account payment stay open. Age from OCRD.Balance, not open documents - naive ageing overstates 1.3-7.5x.
caveats.title: DocStatus='O' is unreliable — age from OCRD.Balance, not open documents
caveats.wrong: Built an ageing by summing open documents (OINV/OPCH DocStatus='O', DocTotal-PaidToDate) and bucketing on DocDueDate, treating 'open' as 'unpaid'.

caveats.right: In the HANA tables the flag has THREE values: 'N' = live, 'Y' = the cancelled original, and 'C' = the system-generated cancellation mirror SAP posts to reverse it. Y and C always appear as exact matching pairs carrying the same value, so a <>'Y' test keeps every mirror and double-counts. Measured live on Oil 2026-08-21: OINV 30,387 'N' (1045.62 Cr) plus 320 'Y' and 320 'C' at 37.27 Cr each; OPCH 16,101 'N' plus 113+113 at 15.96 Cr each; OPDN 10,640 'N' plus 473+473 at 94.63 Cr each; ORDN 1,817 'N' plus 107+107 at 0.49 Cr each. Same pattern in Mart and Beverages. Always test CANCELED='N' positively. Note the Service Layer differs: it exposes only Cancelled 'tYES'/'tNO', so the documented OData filter Cancelled eq 'tNO' is already correct and is not affected.
caveats.rule: HANA "CANCELED" is three-valued: 'N' live, 'Y' cancelled original, 'C' its system mirror. Always filter CANCELED='N' - a <>'Y' test keeps the mirrors and double-counts (Oil OPDN +94.63 Cr).
caveats.title: HANA CANCELED is three-valued — filter ='N', never <>'Y'
caveats.wrong: Excluded cancelled documents in HANA SQL by writing "CANCELED" <> 'Y' (or omitting the filter), assuming the flag is a two-valued Y/N.

caveats.right: C-0017 remains correct as the rule for how to POST a new A/P invoice. It is not a description of what is already in the books. Measured live 2026-08-21 by matching every A/P invoice to its base GRPO via PCH1.BaseEntry/BaseLine: the invoice DocDate equals the GRPO DocDate on only 51.47% of Oil pairs (5,266 of 10,232), 84.22% of Mart and 21.23% of Beverages. Average lag in Oil is 14.1 days, median 0. The practice is tightening in Oil and Mart (Oil by month 2025 ~48%, 2026-06 57.6%, 2026-07 77.0%) but Beverages runs at 9-19% and does not follow it. 28 Oil pairs (0.3%) even carry an invoice dated BEFORE its GRPO. Beware recency bias in the newest months: only 23.1% of Oil's Aug-26 GRPOs are invoiced yet, so recent percentages are computed on the fast-billed minority and 2026-06 is the last trustworthy month. TaxDate behaves as documented: against the GRPO DocDate it is equal 3,109 / before 3,102 / after 4,031, consistent with it carrying the vendor's own invoice date.
caveats.rule: C-0017 is how to POST, not what the books contain: A/P DocDate equals its GRPO DocDate on only 51% of Oil pairs, 84% Mart, 21% Bev. Never infer a gate-in date from an existing A/P invoice.
caveats.title: C-0017 is a posting rule, not a safe assumption when reading GRPO history
caveats.wrong: Treated C-0017 (A/P invoice DocDate = gate-in date = the GRPO's DocDate) as a property of the data, and inferred a receipt date from an A/P invoice's posting date when reading history.

section_traps: FACETED - the single biggest error available here. Seven scopes are stacked in one result (TOTAL, CLASS, MONTH, BRANCH, VENDOR, VENDOR_UNBILLED, WAREHOUSE). Summing every row multiplies the book by roughly seven. The TOTAL row is SCOPE=='TOTAL' AND GRP_KEY=='ALL' - exactly one row per company (verified: 1/1/1).

VENDOR and VENDOR_UNBILLED are TOP-60 and do NOT re-total (SCOPE, GRP_KEY). Verified live: Oil VENDOR sums to 36.43 Cr LESS than TOTAL GRPO_GROSS and VENDOR_UNBILLED to 647.92 Cr less (it is ordered by unbilled value, not receipt value). Re-totalling from a vendor facet silently understates. CLASS, MONTH and BRANCH do re-total to the paisa.

WAREHOUSE money re-totals but WAREHOUSE DOC COUNTS DO NOT (GRPO_DOCS, UNBILLED_DOCS). A receipt spanning two warehouses is counted once in each row - verified live: Oil sums to 10,668 against a TOTAL of 10,663, Mart +2, Bev +7. Never add up GRPO_DOCS across WAREHOUSE.

UNBILLED_GROSS is contaminated by JIVO's own cards. Live today: 64.5% of Beverages' 4.41 Cr is the internal card VENDA001306 'STOCK GOODS RECEIPTS' (which will never receive a vendor bill) and 92% of Mart's 1.97 Cr is VENDA000001 'JIVO WELLNESS PVT LTD'. Quote EXT_UNBILLED_GROSS as the liability and name what came out (C-0005, C-0020).

OPDN.CANCELED is THREE-valued (CANCELED): 'N' live, 'Y' the cancelled original, 'C' SAP's cancellation mirror, and 'Y' and 'C' carry IDENTICAL totals. A '<> Y' filter adds 94.63 Cr of phantom receipts to Oil. The SQL keeps only 'N', on OPDN and on every linked OPCH and ORPD (C-0021).

HAS_AP_INVOICE is NOT the unbilled test (HAS_AP_INVOICE). It is text 'Y'/'N', not 0/1, and a partly-billed receipt reads 'Y' while still carrying unbilled lines. PLAN-V2 section 3.4 proposes 'sum of grpo detail rows where HAS_AP_INVOICE = 0' as the independent check for this KPI: that recipe is WRONG and overstates by 59.73 L (Oil), 41.52 L (Mart) and 35.03 L (Bev) because it sweeps in the CLOSED_NOBILL rows. The correct filter is ROW_KIND=='UNBILLED'.

CLOSED_NOBILL_GROSS is not a liability (CLOSED_NOBILL_GROSS). Somebody closed the receipt and the bill never came - an audit item. Adding it to UNBILLED_GROSS to get 'total exposure' is wrong twice over: it is not owed, and NOINV_GROSS already counts those documents at their FULL value rather than at the offending lines.

NOINV_GROSS is not UNBILLED_GROSS (NOINV_GROSS, UNBILLED_GROSS). NOINV_* counts whole documents with no invoice anywhere at their full receipt value; UNBILLED_* counts only the offending LINES. Live Oil: 7.12 Cr against 6.48 Cr. They are different questions and the names do not say so.

PDN1.OpenQty is broken at JIVO (OpenQty) - it still equals Quantity on fully invoiced closed lines - and OpenInvQty is stated in the BASE UoM while Quantity is in the DOCUMENT UoM (oil RM factor 1098.9). Neither is used, and no quantity arithmetic exists anywhere in this section. Do not add one (C-0001).

That value is INSIDE UNBILLED_GROSS; do not add it on top.

sql.text:
CASE WHEN rt.DOC_ENTRY IS NULL AND b.DOC_ENTRY IS NULL
               AND l."LineStatus" = 'O'                            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS UB,
         CASE WHEN rt.DOC_ENTRY IS NULL AND b.DOC_ENTRY IS NULL
               AND l."LineStatus" = 'C'                            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS CNB,
         iv.INV_COUNT, iv.FIRST_INV_DATE
  FROM HDR hd
  JOIN {{SCHEMA}}.PDN1 l ON l."DocEntry" = hd.DOC_ENTRY
  LEFT JOIN BILLED   b  ON b.DOC_ENTRY  = l."DocEntry" AND b.LINE_NUM  = l."LineNum"
  LEFT JOIN RETURNED rt ON rt.DOC_ENTRY = l."DocEntry" AND rt.LINE_NUM = l."LineNum"
  LEFT JOIN INVLINK  iv ON iv.DOC_ENTRY = hd.DOC_ENTRY
),
LF AS (  -- line fact with every per-row measure spelled out once
  SELECT DOC_ENTRY, DOC_DATE, DOC_STATUS, CARD_CODE, CARD_NAME, PARTY_CLASS,
         BPL_ID, BPL_NAME, AGE_DAYS, WHS, NET, GST, GROSS,
         1                          AS N_LINES,
         UB                         AS UB_LINES,
         UB * NET                   AS UB_NET,
         UB * GST                   AS UB_GST,
         UB * GROSS                 AS UB_GROSS,
         UB * ZERO_QTY              AS UB_ZQ_LINES,
         UB * ZERO_QTY * GROSS      AS UB_ZQ_GROSS,
         CNB                        AS CNB_LINES,
         CNB * GROSS                AS CNB_GROSS,
         RETURNED                   AS RET_LINES,
         RETURNED * GROSS           AS RET_GROSS,
         CASE WHEN UB  = 1 THEN DOC_DATE  END                       AS UB_DATE,
         CASE WHEN UB  = 1 THEN DOC_ENTRY END                       AS UB_DOC,
         CASE WHEN CNB = 1 THEN DOC_ENTRY END                       AS CNB_DOC,
         CASE WHEN RETURNED = 1 THEN DOC_ENTRY END                  AS RET_DOC,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS <=  30              THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_0_30,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS BETWEEN  31 AND  60 THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_31_60,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS BETWEEN  61 AND  90 THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_61_90,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS BETWEEN  91 AND 180 THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_91_180,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS BETWEEN 181 AND 365 THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_181_365,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS >  365              THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_365PLUS,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS >   90              THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END AS UB_90P_GROSS,
         CASE WHEN UB = 1 AND AGE_DAYS >   90 THEN DOC_ENTRY END                 AS UB_90P_DOC,
         CASE WHEN INV_COUNT > 0     THEN DOC_ENTRY END                          AS INV_DOC,
         CASE WHEN INV_COUNT IS NULL THEN DOC_ENTRY END                          AS NOINV_DOC,
         CASE WHEN INV_COUNT IS NULL THEN GROSS ELSE 0 END                       AS NOINV_GROSS,
         INV_COUNT, FIRST_INV_DATE
  FROM L
),
DF AS (  -- DOCUMENT-level fact: the SAME measure vocabulary, one row per GRPO.
         -- Only this level carries the C-0017 invoice-lag numbers, because a lag
         -- is a property of the document and not of any one line (trap 10).
  SELECT DOC_ENTRY,
         MIN(DOC_DATE) AS DOC_DATE, MIN(CARD_CODE) AS CARD_CODE, MIN(CARD_NAME) AS CARD_NAME,
         MIN(PARTY_CLASS) AS PARTY_CLASS, MIN(BPL_ID) AS BPL_ID, MIN(BPL_NAME) AS BPL_NAME,
         SUM(N_LINES) AS N_LINES, SUM(NET) AS NET, SUM(GST) AS GST, SUM(GROSS) AS GROSS,
         SUM(UB_LINES) AS UB_LINES, SUM(UB_NET) AS UB_NET, SUM(UB_GST) AS UB_GST,
         SUM(UB_GROSS) AS UB_GROSS, SUM(UB_ZQ_LINES) AS UB_ZQ_LINES, SUM(UB_ZQ_GROSS) AS UB_ZQ_GROSS,
         SUM(CNB_LINES) AS CNB_LINES, SUM(CNB_GROSS) AS CNB_GROSS,
         SUM(RET_LINES) AS RET_LINES, SUM(RET_GROSS) AS RET_GROSS,
         MIN(UB_DATE) AS UB_DATE, MIN(UB_DOC) AS UB_DOC, MIN(CNB_DOC) AS CNB_DOC, MIN(RET_DOC) AS RET_DOC,
         SUM(UB_0_30) AS UB_0_30, SUM(UB_31_60) AS UB_31_60, SUM(UB_61_90) AS UB_61_90,
         SUM(UB_91_180) AS UB_91_180, SUM(UB_181_365) AS UB_181_365, SUM(UB_365PLUS) AS UB_365PLUS,
         SUM(UB_90P_GROSS) AS UB_90P_GROSS, MIN(UB_90P_DOC) AS UB_90P_DOC,
         MIN(INV_DOC) AS INV_DOC, MIN(NOINV_DOC) AS NOINV_DOC, SUM(NOINV_GROSS) AS NOINV_GROSS,
         MIN(CASE WHEN INV_COUNT > 0 THEN DAYS_BETWEEN(DOC_DATE, FIRST_INV_DATE) END) AS INV_LAG,
         MIN(CASE WHEN INV_COUNT > 0 AND DAYS_BETWEEN(DOC_DATE, FIRST_INV_DATE) = 0
                  THEN DOC_ENTRY END) AS SAMEDAY_DOC
  FROM LF
  GROUP BY DOC_ENTRY
),
SCOPES AS (
  -- six DOCUMENT-level scopes, stacked; WAREHOUSE is added from the line fact below
              SELECT 'TOTAL'           AS S, '1' AS SK FROM DUMMY
  UNION ALL   SELECT 'CLASS',               '2'        FROM DUMMY
  UNION ALL   SELECT 'MONTH',               '3'        FROM DUMMY
  UNION ALL   SELECT 'BRANCH',              '4'        FROM DUMMY
  UNION ALL   SELECT 'VENDOR',              '5'        FROM DUMMY
  UNION ALL   SELECT 'VENDOR_UNBILLED',     '6'        FROM DUMMY
),
KEYED AS (
  SELECT s.S AS SCOPE,
         CASE s.S WHEN 'TOTAL'  THEN 'ALL'
                  WHEN 'CLASS'  THEN d.PARTY_CLASS
                  WHEN 'MONTH'  THEN TO_VARCHAR(d.DOC_DATE,'YYYY-MM')
                  WHEN 'BRANCH' THEN d.BPL_ID
                  ELSE d.CARD_CODE END                                  AS GRP_KEY,
         CASE s.S WHEN 'TOTAL'  THEN 'All GRPOs'
                  WHEN 'CLASS'  THEN d.PARTY_CLASS
                  WHEN 'MONTH'  THEN TO_VARCHAR(d.DOC_DATE,'YYYY-MM')
                  WHEN 'BRANCH' THEN UPPER(d.BPL_NAME)   -- OPDN."BPLName" is stored per DOCUMENT and its
                                                         -- capitalisation drifted ('FACTORY' vs 'Factory'),
                                                         -- which split branch 2 into two rows until upper-cased
                  ELSE d.CARD_NAME || ' [' || d.PARTY_CLASS || ']' END  AS GRP_LABEL,
         s.SK AS SORT_KEY,
         d.DOC_ENTRY, d.N_LINES, d.NET, d.GST, d.GROSS,
         d.UB_LINES, d.UB_NET, d.UB_GST, d.UB_GROSS, d.UB_ZQ_LINES, d.UB_ZQ_GROSS,
         d.CNB_LINES, d.CNB_GROSS, d.RET_LINES, d.RET_GROSS,
         d.UB_DATE, d.UB_DOC, d.CNB_DOC, d.RET_DOC,
         d.UB_0_30, d.UB_31_60, d.UB_61_90, d.UB_91_180, d.UB_181_365, d.UB_365PLUS,
         d.UB_90P_GROSS, d.UB_90P_DOC, d.INV_DOC, d.NOINV_DOC, d.NOINV_GROSS,
         d.INV_LAG, d.SAMEDAY_DOC, d.PARTY_CLASS AS PCLASS
  FROM DF d CROSS JOIN SCOPES s
),
KEYED_W AS (   -- WAREHOUSE: line-level, invoice-lag columns deliberately NULL (trap 10)
  SELECT 'WAREHOUSE' AS SCOPE, f.WHS AS GRP_KEY, f.WHS AS GRP_LABEL, '7' AS SORT_KEY,
         f.DOC_ENTRY, f.N_LINES, f.NET, f.GST, f.GROSS,
         f.UB_LINES, f.UB_NET, f.UB_GST, f.UB_GROSS, f.UB_ZQ_LINES, f.UB_ZQ_GROSS,
         f.CNB_LINES, f.CNB_GROSS, f.RET_LINES, f.RET_GROSS,
         f.UB_DATE, f.UB_DOC, f.CNB_DOC, f.RET_DOC,
         f.UB_0_30, f.UB_31_60, f.UB_61_90, f.UB_91_180, f.UB_181_365, f.UB_365PLUS,
         f.UB_90P_GROSS, f.UB_90P_DOC, f.INV_DOC, f.NOINV_DOC, f.NOINV_GROSS,
         CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS INV_LAG, CAST(NULL AS INTEGER) AS SAMEDAY_DOC,
         f.PARTY_CLASS AS PCLASS
  FROM LF f
),
AGG AS (
  SELECT SCOPE, GRP_KEY, GRP_LABEL, SORT_KEY,

section_traps: CO_*, DT_* and CARD_* are BROADCAST AGGREGATES repeated on every row they describe. Summing CO_OPEN_ALL down the oil slice gives Rs 5,60,806 Cr instead of Rs 2,586.70 Cr — a 2,168x overstatement. Read CO_* off summary[0], DT_* off the first row of each DOCTYPE, CARD_* off the first row of each CARD_CODE. The only per-row money columns are DOC_TOTAL, APPLIED, OPEN_AMT, SIGNED_OPEN, OPEN_AMT_FC, ITEM_REAL_EST, OITR_RECON_AMT.

THE ROW SET IS CAPPED AND FLOORED, and nothing in the row data says so except CO_ITEMS_SHOWN vs CO_ITEMS_ALL. Only documents with OPEN_AMT >= Rs 10,000 that rank in the company's top 1,500 or their own doctype's top 400 are delivered — 2,168 of 23,240 (oil), 2,188 of 10,105 (mart), 1,096 of 2,212 (bev). Any KPI computed by summing the delivered rows is a SHOWN-SET figure and must be labelled as one. This is exactly the v1 bug the notes record: the doctype bar chart summed shown rows under an uncapped headline, drawing Rs 2,516 Cr of bars beneath a Rs 2,582 Cr number.

CO_OPEN_ALL IS NOT MONEY OWED, AND IS THE MOST DANGEROUS NUMBER ON THE BOARD. Oil shows Rs 2,586.70 Cr of open documents against Rs 12.89 Cr of actual ledger balance across the same parties — a 200x gap. Two causes, both measured: 76.6% is migration openings dated 2024-09-30, and the rest is DocStatus='O' being unreliable at JIVO because bills are settled by manual journal entry or unmatched on-account payments (C-0019). The receivable and payable figures come from customer-ageing / vendor-ageing, which anchor on OCRD.Balance. Every panel that shows CO_OPEN_ALL must carry that sentence.

DOCTYPE AND SIDE ARE DIFFERENT AXES. DOCTYPE names the SAP table; SIDE names the party's ledger side, derived from the payment's own DocType. Filtering by DOCTYPE='AR_RCT' when you meant 'customer receipts' pulls in ORCT rows with DocType='S' — cash received back FROM A VENDOR — worth Rs 2.25 Cr across 146 oil documents. Mirror image: 26 oil OVPM rows (Rs 25.86 L) are refunds paid TO A CUSTOMER and are SIDE='AR'. This was defect D1; after the fix SIDE agrees with OCRD.CardType on 100% of rows, so any disagreement is now a hard defect signal.

DAYS_OVERDUE AND AGE_DAYS DISAGREE BY YEARS ON MIGRATED ROWS, and both are correct. Oil's worst row is dated 2024-09-30 (691 days old) with a true original due date of 2020-02-19 (2,376 days overdue). AGE_BUCKET is cut on DAYS_OVERDUE, so 87.9% of Oil's shown value lands in 365+ largely because of pre-go-live due dates. Never write 'this document is N days old' from DAYS_OVERDUE, and never write 'N days overdue' from AGE_DAYS. On payments (AR_RCT/AP_PMT) DUE_DATE is the payment's own and means nothing as a deadline — AGE_DAYS is the honest field there.

ITEM_REAL_EST MUST BE SUMMED SIGNED OR NOT AT ALL. It is OPEN_AMT × CARD_REAL_PCT/100, and CARD_REAL_PCT is a ratio of NETS applied to GROSS amounts. A card whose large debits and credits offset gets 100% and every one of its rows is estimated at its full face value: Mart's VENDA000001 sums to Rs 347.86 Cr of 'really open' against a card balance of −Rs 20.93 Cr. Gross-summing it across Mart's shown rows yields Rs 505.88 Cr against a CO_OCRD_NET of −Rs 9.39 Cr, which is nonsense. 233 of 421 oil cards, 17 of 50 mart, 43 of 306 bev overstate this way. SUM(SGN × ITEM_REAL_EST) per card = sign(net) × min(|net|,|balance|) — verified on all 265 fully-contained cards — and that is the only defensible total. Recommendation: do NOT publish a company-level 'really open' KPI from this column; expose it per row and per card only.

OPEN_AMT_FC IS NOT RUPEES AND ITS COLUMN IS NOT ADDABLE. OPEN_AMT is always local INR; OPEN_AMT_FC is the same item in its own currency, so totalling the column adds USD to EUR to zero. 107 oil rows are non-INR and they are Rs 2,103.78 Cr of the Rs 2,519.74 Cr shown — 83% of the book is exchange-rate exposed. Worse, rows with a rotten DocRate are INVISIBLE: Oil OVPM 26317 books USD 44.34 L as Rs 443.40 (~87,000x too small) and sinks below the Rs 10,000 floor entirely. One such row was found; no systematic sweep was run.

OITR_RECON_AMT CAN EXCEED THE DOCUMENT'S OWN TOTAL AND THAT IS NOT A BUG. SAP writes account-level system reconciliations that stamp the reconciliation's whole total onto each participant line, so 87 oil / 14 mart / 1 bev documents legitimately carry more reconciliation than value. It is a DIAGNOSTIC, never a settlement figure, and it is never used to compute OPEN_AMT. It is also easy to break: the naive SUM over ITR1's signed lines double-counted settlements written on both IsCredit sides and fired FULL_PER_OITR on documents SAP had not reconciled (128 impossible rows and Rs 18.24 Cr of phantom excess in Oil before defect D2 was fixed). If the impossible-row count jumps back toward 128, the GREATEST(D,C) guard has been removed.

MART'S SHOWN LIST IS 67.2% INTERCOMPANY BY VALUE (Rs 356.62 Cr of Rs 530.98 Cr), 68.2% once its BRANCH cards are added (Rs 362.29 Cr = the IS_GROUP=1 figure) — and VENDA000001 'JIVO WELLNESS PVT LTD' alone is Rs 347.86 Cr across 1,070 documents. Any Mart headline read without ACCT_KIND in front of it is mostly JIVO trading with itself (C-0005). Oil is 6.8% group (BRANCH 5.1% + INTERCO 1.7%), Bev 11.6% (BRANCH 11.1% + INTERCO 0.5%). Group parties are flagged and kept here, never dropped — the board must let the reader subtract them consciously.

BPL_NAME IS INCONSISTENTLY CASED IN SAP. Oil carries both 'FACTORY' and 'Factory' and both 'DELHI' and 'Delhi'; Bev carries 'FACTORY'/'Factory', 'DELHI'/'Delhi' and 'Punjab'. Grouping without UPPER() splits one branch into two bars and understates the larger one.

EXT_REF IS NULL ON EVERY PAYMENT ROW and on many invoices — 1,344 of 2,168 oil rows, 909 of 2,188 mart, 883 of 1,096 bev. It is the ONLY nullable column in the 51. A naive String(v) prints the literal 'None'.

OBJ_TYPE AND DOC_ENTRY ARRIVE WITH MIXED JSON TYPES. The SQL declares OBJ_TYPE as a string but data.json holds it as an INTEGER (13, 14, 18, 19, 24, 46), while DOC_ENTRY — a numeric key in SAP — arrives as a STRING. Cast both before building a document URL or the link silently 404s.

AS_OF FILTERS DocDate ONLY. PaidToDate, OpenBal and OCRD.Balance are live values with no history in these tables, so a back-dated run gives 'documents that existed on that date, with today's settlement state' — not the open position as it stood. Measured on Oil: --as-of 2026-03-31 reports Rs 80.34 Cr adjusted receivable against Rs 108.86 Cr today. Never label a back-dated run as a closing position.

STAFF IS A GROUP-NAME TEST ONLY, so employee imprest cards filed under a geography group (ORGC000031 'ARVINDER SINGH IMPREST JWPL0115', group DELHI) come out as TRADE. Measured cost: 11 items / Rs 1.27 L (oil), 2 / Rs 1,957 (mart), 6 / Rs 11,562 (bev). Immaterial, deliberately left — but do not present the TRADE figure as 'purely external' without this footnote.

NEGATIVE OpenBal ROWS ARE SILENTLY DROPPED by the > 0 filter: 2 oil rows (−Rs 0.91), 2 mart (−Rs 1,025), 0 bev. Total Rs 1,025.91 across all three books. Immaterial, but it is why the ORCT/OVPM totals here differ by exactly that amount from a raw table scan.

data.json MOVES UNDER YOU. The VPS rebuilds it every 2 minutes. Between 18:58:48 and 19:05:02 on 2026-08-22 Oil's CO_OPEN_ALL moved +Rs 40.32 L on a single new A/R invoice — and CO_OCRD_NET moved by the identical amount, leaving CO_STALE_GAP unchanged, which is exactly the behaviour a correct pipeline should show. Any regression test must compare shape and identities, not frozen paise.

sql.text:
CASE WHEN i.DAYS_OVERDUE <=   0 THEN '0_NOTDUE'
              WHEN i.DAYS_OVERDUE <=  30 THEN '1_1-30'
              WHEN i.DAYS_OVERDUE <=  60 THEN '2_31-60'
              WHEN i.DAYS_OVERDUE <=  90 THEN '3_61-90'
              WHEN i.DAYS_OVERDUE <= 180 THEN '4_91-180'
              WHEN i.DAYS_OVERDUE <= 365 THEN '5_181-365'
              ELSE '6_365+' END                          AS AGE_BUCKET,

caveats.right: In the HANA tables the flag has THREE values: 'N' = live, 'Y' = the cancelled original, and 'C' = the system-generated cancellation mirror SAP posts to reverse it. Y and C always appear as exact matching pairs carrying the same value, so a <>'Y' test keeps every mirror and double-counts. Measured live on Oil 2026-08-21: OINV 30,387 'N' (1045.62 Cr) plus 320 'Y' and 320 'C' at 37.27 Cr each; OPCH 16,101 'N' plus 113+113 at 15.96 Cr each; OPDN 10,640 'N' plus 473+473 at 94.63 Cr each; ORDN 1,817 'N' plus 107+107 at 0.49 Cr each. Same pattern in Mart and Beverages. Always test CANCELED='N' positively. Note the Service Layer differs: it exposes only Cancelled 'tYES'/'tNO', so the documented OData filter Cancelled eq 'tNO' is already correct and is not affected.
caveats.rule: HANA "CANCELED" is three-valued: 'N' live, 'Y' cancelled original, 'C' its system mirror. Always filter CANCELED='N' - a <>'Y' test keeps the mirrors and double-counts (Oil OPDN +94.63 Cr).
caveats.title: HANA CANCELED is three-valued — filter ='N', never <>'Y'
caveats.wrong: Excluded cancelled documents in HANA SQL by writing "CANCELED" <> 'Y' (or omitting the filter), assuming the flag is a two-valued Y/N.

caveats.right: C-0017 remains correct as the rule for how to POST a new A/P invoice. It is not a description of what is already in the books. Measured live 2026-08-21 by matching every A/P invoice to its base GRPO via PCH1.BaseEntry/BaseLine: the invoice DocDate equals the GRPO DocDate on only 51.47% of Oil pairs (5,266 of 10,232), 84.22% of Mart and 21.23% of Beverages. Average lag in Oil is 14.1 days, median 0. The practice is tightening in Oil and Mart (Oil by month 2025 ~48%, 2026-06 57.6%, 2026-07 77.0%) but Beverages runs at 9-19% and does not follow it. 28 Oil pairs (0.3%) even carry an invoice dated BEFORE its GRPO. Beware recency bias in the newest months: only 23.1% of Oil's Aug-26 GRPOs are invoiced yet, so recent percentages are computed on the fast-billed minority and 2026-06 is the last trustworthy month. TaxDate behaves as documented: against the GRPO DocDate it is equal 3,109 / before 3,102 / after 4,031, consistent with it carrying the vendor's own invoice date.
caveats.rule: C-0017 is how to POST, not what the books contain: A/P DocDate equals its GRPO DocDate on only 51% of Oil pairs, 84% Mart, 21% Bev. Never infer a gate-in date from an existing A/P invoice.
caveats.title: C-0017 is a posting rule, not a safe assumption when reading GRPO history
caveats.wrong: Treated C-0017 (A/P invoice DocDate = gate-in date = the GRPO's DocDate) as a property of the data, and inferred a receipt date from an A/P invoice's posting date when reading history.

sql.text:
SELECT 'AP_INV', 'AP', -1, '18',
         "DocEntry", "DocNum", CAST(IFNULL("NumAtCard",'') AS NVARCHAR(100)),
         "CardCode", "BPLId", CAST(IFNULL("BPLName",'') AS NVARCHAR(200)),
         CAST("DocDate" AS DATE), CAST("DocDueDate" AS DATE),
         CAST("DocTotal" AS DOUBLE), CAST("PaidToDate" AS DOUBLE),
         CAST("DocTotal" - "PaidToDate" AS DOUBLE),
         CAST("DocCur" AS NVARCHAR(3)),
         CAST(IFNULL("DocTotalFC",0) - IFNULL("PaidFC",0) AS DOUBLE)
  FROM {{SCHEMA}}.OPCH
  WHERE "CANCELED" = 'N' AND "DocStatus" = 'O'
    AND CAST("DocTotal" - "PaidToDate" AS DOUBLE) > 0
    AND CAST("DocDate" AS DATE) <= DATE'{{ASOF}}'
